name: Dismiss Zombie
description: Backs a level-1 undead (e.g., Zombie) to a barrier and dismisses its spirit; caster must maintain the dismissal until it collapses.

name: Cure Wound
description: Cures 6 tblp to total body and touched location (or 2 Hits to monsters). Does not affect the undead.

name: Temporary Bless
description: Places a temporary blessing on a target for 1 hour.

name: Dismiss Skeleton
description: As Dismiss Zombie but for level-2 (or level-1) undead; forces it back and collapses it when cornered.

name: Befriend Spirit
description: Target treats the priest as a very trusted friend; retains free will. If betrayed, the spirit strikes back for level-based tblp.

name: Bless
description: Blesses a person or item (generally 24 hours; special permanent cases as noted for specific classes).

name: Cure Disease
description: Removes physical or spiritual diseases (not magically inflicted ones).

name: Control Skeleton
description: Controls one level-2 or level-1 undead as per Control Zombie with noted differences.

name: Protection from Spirits
description: Creates a chalk line that bars spirits of a chosen alignment (Good or Evil) from crossing/attacking through it within listed limits.

name: Spirit Shield
description: Absorbs the first 18 tblp of purely spiritual damage or undead touch effects (6 pts per touch) on the recipient.

name: Communication
description: Ask three yes/no questions of knowledgeable spirits within five minutes; silence if unknown.

name: Spirit Bolt
description: Ranged spiritual attack: 18 tblp to characters (applies SAC of least-protected location) or 6 Hits to monsters.

name: Control Ghoul
description: Controls one Ghoul (or other level-3 or lower undead) for the duration; can perform complex tasks.

name: Rune of Power
description: Inscribe and set a spiritual rune that triggers as described in its rules.

name: Halt Undead
description: Halts undead as per standard Halt; the phrase 'spirit of... I dismiss thee hence' counts as a blow for this miracle.

name: Repel Undead
description: Repels undead up to 21' as per the Paladinic effect.
sphere: Minor Dismissal / Minor Force / Minor Warding

name: Cure Insanity
description: Removes all insanities currently afflicting the target.

name: Warming Touch
description: Removes spiritual freeze effects from one target.
sphere: Minor Benediction / Minor Dismissal / Minor Healing

name: Remove Rune of Power
description: Negates an untriggered Rune of Power.

name: Spirit Dart
description: As Spirit Bolt but 6 tblp (or 2 Hits to monsters).

name: Milly's Detect Spirits
description: Reveals location of all spirits within 20' of the caster.

name: Set Ward
description: Allows the caster to freely pass in/out of their own Ward of Power without collapse or harm.

name: Runed Ally
description: Marks a target to be immune to the caster’s own Warding-tree baneful effects for the adventure (releasable).

name: Enhance Rune of Power
description: Upgrades a just-placed Rune of Power to affect up to 11 levels of spiritual resistance.

name: Minor Prayer
description: One Communication-style yes/no question (single question) within 30 seconds.

name: Enhance Stasis
description: As Stasis but affects targets up to caster level; 20-second duration; does not affect undead.

name: Force Touch
description: Short-duration force imbue (touch-based) as described in the entry.

name: Spirit Sundering
description: Double-effect Spirit Bolt for 36 tblp neutral spirit damage; normal Spirit Bolt resistances/SAC apply.

name: Overwhelming Force
description: Within 30s, touch a spirit to inflict Repel 20', Knockdown, and a non-level-based Halt.

name: Greater Spirit Shield
description: As Spirit Shield but absorbs 36 tblp; Minor Warding/Benediction sphere.

name: Bar Spirit
description: Bars a named (or indicated) spirit from crossing a Protection-style barrier for the duration.

name: Warding Rune of Defence
description: Self-inscribed defensive rune that retaliates on aggressors as described.

name: Dark Sundering
description: 36 tblp evil spirit damage (12 Hits to monsters). Spirit Bolt resistances and SAC apply; Causes resistances do not.

name: Command Undead
description: Controls undead up to level 9; spirit cost scales by undead level up to 14sp max; special exception for Animate-Life’d PCs.

name: Weakness
description: On touch within 30s, target loses 1 strength grade (cannot stack); immunity to strength-drain applies; does not affect undead.

name: Walk Through Walls
description: Caster moves through walls like a wraith for 5 minutes with noted casting/usage limits.

name: Touched by Evil
description: Protective undead-realm shroud around a target; details as per entry.

name: Wither
description: Touch causes a non-critical limb to become unusable; releasable; regeneration counters; does not affect undead.

name: Mass Paralysis
description: Paralyses all within 10' as per Paralysis; releasable (releases all at once); affects undead.

name: Mallerstang's Cloak of the Inconsequential
description: Others ignore the caster as if not there until they attack or draw attention; domination/perception immunities apply; releasable.

name: Flood of Putrescence
description: Inflicts spiritual Disease on all in range (including caster); releasable releases all diseases simultaneously.

name: Lack of Faith
description: Target cannot cast sub-8th-level miracles for 60s; Resistances to Lack of Faith halve duration and restore casting by 1 level band.

name: Spiritual Candles
description: Creates four spiritual candles suitable for Restore Life (Good) or Animate Life (Evil).

name: Voice of Retribution
description: As Voice of Power but only the command “Die!”; affects up to caster level and only vs. the opposite alignment; does not affect undead.

name: Spirit Strike
description: Like Spirit Bolt but 36 tblp (12 Hits to monsters) AND a Halt (up to 8 levels); Halt doesn’t affect undead.

name: Rod of Righteousness
description: Creates a purely spiritual O-class rod of caster’s alignment (+1 vs. opposite-aligned spirits) usable only by the caster.

name: Create Skeletal Knight
description: As Animate Skeleton but tougher: not bound to point, blunt/spiritual only damage, +1 strength, DL 7, triple normal skeleton Hits.

name: Animate Life
description: Evil resurrection analogue that returns a target as ‘Animate Life’; has unique undead interactions and protection requirements.

name: Embody Wight Spirit
description: Caster mingles with a Wight’s spirit to gain its dark travel for the duration.

name: Halt
description: Freeze a lower-level target in place for ~10 seconds; broken by any touch/damage; does not affect undead.

name: Power Meld
description: Touch a willing lower-level priest to transfer all their remaining spirits to you (donor also loses 1 life per spirit); excess dissipates after 5 minutes.

name: Detect Spirit's Nature
description: Discerns the alignment of a target spirit (Good/Neutral/Evil); no response if no spirit.

name: Spirit of Seeing
description: Send a spirit to look and report; short, immediate informational glimpse in a pointed direction.

name: Cure Serious Wounds
description: Cure 12 tblp (or 4 Hits to a monster) distributed across locations as desired; not effective on undead.

name: Control Zombie
description: Take control of a zombie's spirit (or other level-1 undead by name) for 30 minutes, overcoming equal/lower controller level.

name: Talk to Spirit
description: Ask three yes/no (one-word) questions of a spirit within range; powerful living/intelligent undead may lie, lesser cannot.

name: Dismiss Ghoul
description: Dismiss one level-3 undead (e.g., Ghoul) by forcing it back to a barrier and completing the dismissal phrase at ~9’ distance.

name: Dismiss Mummy
description: Dismiss one level-4 undead (e.g., Mummy) by forcing it back; it can still attack others who come too close during dismissal.

name: Heal
description: Cure up to 36 tblp (or 12 Hits to a monster), distributed across locations; does not affect undead.

name: Minor Ward of Power
description: Draw a four-cornered ward that bars low-level undead and creatures ≤4th level; inflicts spiritual damage on crossing; absorbs 10sp of directed miracles.

name: Remove Voice of Power
description: Cancel one Voice of Power currently affecting a target; also removes Halt/Stasis-type effects.

name: Voice of Power
description: Command a single-word imperative a lower-level target must obey (e.g., Sleep/Flee/Obey); listed stopping effect; does not affect undead.

name: Dismiss Wraith
description: Dismiss one level-5 undead (e.g., Wraith); when dismissal begins it cannot walk through walls; complete at ~9’ with the release phrase.

name: Remove Fear and Paralysis
description: Touch to end fear and paralysis effects currently afflicting the target; standard limitations per entry.

name: Control Wraith
description: Control one level-5 (or lower) undead; if cast immediately after you summon it, control lasts 30 minutes, otherwise 5 minutes.

name: Greater Communication
description: As Communication but answers are short phrases/sentences (≈7 relevant words); three questions in five minutes.

name: Major Ward of Power
description: As Minor Ward but stronger: bars all undead; bars creatures with resistance levels up to 7th; deals heavy spiritual damage on crossing; absorbs 20sp of directed miracles.

name: Cause Minor Wound
description: Touch to inflict minor spiritual injury to a living target.

name: Cause Serious Wounds
description: Touch to inflict serious spiritual injury to a living target.

name: Curse
description: Either impose -2 DAC for 24h or grant +2 DAC for 1h to an evil target behaving evilly; can also curse objects; special dying-curse rules apply.

name: Animate Skeleton
description: Raise one skeleton from a suitable corpse; gains hits based on your level; half damage from sharp; weak inherent control for 30 minutes.

name: Cause Disease
description: Inflict a spiritual or physical disease on a living target, per ref notes; object-cursing interactions as noted.

name: Cause Fear
description: Instil fear in a living target, per listed stopping/level rules.

name: Beguile Spirit
description: Charm-like sway over a living target’s spirit (not full control), as per entry’s limits.

name: Create Ghoul
description: Create a ghoul from a suitable corpse with stats per system; under your control per create/control rules.

name: Create Mummy
description: Create a mummy from a suitable corpse with stats per system; under your control per create/control rules.

name: Dismiss Vampire
description: Dismiss a level-6 undead (e.g., Vampire) by forcing it back to a barrier and completing the release phrase at the end.

name: Spiritual Freedom
description: This miracle enables the priest to remove a Spiritual Mastery miracle. It also removes Beguile and Befriend Spirit miracles and will remove any physical versions of the above.

name: Regeneration
description: This miracle enables a priest to regenerate a severed limb. On completion of the incantation, the limb will begin to grow and it will be fully usable after 5 minutes. This miracle only works on living targets. In the case of missing body-parts other than limbs, such as the eyes, the miracle's effects are generally deemed to be instant, at ref's discretion. This miracle does not affect the undead.

name: Reveal Truth
description: This miracle enables a priest to ask a spirit whether a statement he has heard recently has been the truth or a lie. The statement must have been made by a being with a spirit. The ref should inform the caster whether the speaker believed the statement or did not believe it (i.e. was lying). The actual truth of the statement does not matter, only the speaker's perception of it. Rather than repeating the statement, the priest may simply utter the verbal immediately after a statement – in this case the miracle affects the last statement heard, whatever that may have been. In a change from previous this now allows statements to be checked for a 5minute period. Each statement must be repeated or the verbal used after each one. Alternatively a single statement may be checked at any time after it has been heard. Differences/Additional rules: a Conceal Lie miracle does not work against it. For the duration of the miracle the priest recognises any and all lies spoken by someone with a spirit.

name: Total Heal
description: This miracle enables a priest to totally heal a character or monster of all damage, if both priest and recipient spend 30 seconds in calm preparation before the invocation, the priest praying to their patron and neither party in combat. If the miracle is cast without this preparation it cures only 72 tblp and 72 points of locational damage. This is an absolute system limit, and no ability under any circumstances circumvents this. Note that on creatures with half a spirit, like half-Elves, Total Heal only cures 72 points as above if prepared and only 36 points if unprepared. This miracle does not affect the undead.

name: Restore Life
description: This miracle allows a recently dead (up to 2 weeks of real time) character or monster to be brought back to life. The priest is drained of a level if this miracle is used successfully – immunity to level drain and similar abilities do not apply to this loss, as the miracle is cast voluntarily. The body should be placed in a circle of Protection from Spirits (evil) with a lit candle (or safe phys rep candle) at each shoulder and at each foot. If the miracle is successful, the person restored to life has 7 total body life points and 1 location life point at each location (even if they had suffered unhealable wounds that would prevent this). A monster, if resurrected, has 2 hits. If for any reason this miracle fails to work, then the priest still loses 10 spirits and 10 life points. If the person remains at rest within the general area (20ft) of where they were restored to life do not cast/engage in combat they will be completely healed 5 minutes later. Note there is no longer a "disease" effect associated with a restore life. If a character has died from Level Drain then they are returned at

name: Spirit of Seeing and Hearing
description: This miracle is very similar to the Spirit of Seeing miracle. It has all the effects of a Spirit of Seeing and can also read the surface thoughts of any spirits in the area and so tell their short-term intent. In general, non- animate spirits, such as those in items or active miracles, will not have thoughts!

name: Stasis
description: The effects of this miracle are as the Halt miracle in most ways except for Range and duration. The only other difference is that a touch is not sufficient to free the target of a Stasis – only actual damage will suffice.

name: Detect Lie
description: This miracle enables a priest to ask a spirit whether a statement he has heard recently has been the truth or a lie. The statement must have been made by a being with a spirit. The ref should inform the caster whether the speaker believed the statement or did not believe it (i.e. was lying). The actual truth of the statement does not matter, only the speaker's perception of it. Rather than repeating the statement, the priest may simply utter the verbal immediately after a statement – in this case the miracle affects the last statement heard, whatever that may have been. In a change from previous this now allows statements to be checked for a 5minute period. Each statement must be repeated or the verbal used after each one. Alternatively a single statement may be checked at any time after it has been heard.

name: Control Mummy
description: This miracle enables a priest to take over control of a spirit animating a zombie. If the level of the priest performing the miracle is higher or equal to the level of the priest currently controlling the zombie, then the miracle succeeds otherwise it fails. For control purposes, an uncontrolled zombie or a zombie under the control that is inherent in the Animate Zombie miracle, is considered to be controlled only by a Differences/Additional rules: one level 4 or below undead is affected.

name: Spiritual Invisibility
description: The caster's spirit cannot be perceived by any spirit and thus is immune to ALL spiritual effects. This includes all miracles. The caster cannot cast miracles or even use innate (spiritual) abilities, excepting that the priest may remove his own Spiritual Invisibility miracle. Spiritual Invisibility can only be cast on the caster. This miracle does not affect the undead.

name: Animate Zombie
description: This miracle enables a priest to summon spirits to enter dead bodies to create zombies. A priest can generally create zombies out of bodies that are up to 28 days old, or otherwise ruled by the ref to have remained fleshy. The priest is able to animate 4 hits + 1 hit per level of the priest in zombies and can spread this number of hits amongst the zombies in any combination he likes. e.g. A

name: Temporary Curse
description: This miracle enables a priest to curse a person for a limited period of time. The effect of this miracle is to spiritually slow the victim's reactions to the extent that the victim loses 2 points of dexterity AC, to a minimum of 0. If this miracle is cast on a monster then it reduces the monster's AC by 2 points alternatively if the monster is not set with AC it decreases the monsters remaining hits by four. The minimum hits a monster can be left with after being cursed is one, as clearly the miracle cannot kill but merely increase the amount of damage the victim receives during combat. This miracle is also known as 'Damn'. Alternatively, the miracle can be cast upon a target of Evil alignment beneficially, instead granting them 2 Dexterity AC in a manner similar to Temporary Bless. However in this case the miracle lasts only 5 minutes. Objects may also be cursed, and this functions as detailed under Temporary Bless. All priests of any alignment are able to cast a miracle of equivalent effect to Damn, as a final dying Damn, as long as they have at least 2 spirits remaining. The priest need not have this miracle on his guild miracle list though he must be at least second level. The dying priest always has enough time to utter the incantation before he expires providing he says it at the instant of death. The verbal for this curse is "With my dying breath I damn thee". This miracle if cast as a dying damn, is not removed by the involuntary Remove Own Miracle cast during the death trauma. The priest is deemed to spend the agony of his death trauma willing retribution on his slayer. This miracle cancels the effect of a Temporary Bless, though it has no effect on a full Bless.

name: Conceal Lie
description: This miracle enables a priest to counteract the effects of a Detect Lie miracle, or any other form of Lie Detection power used by someone with a spirit, such as neuronic Detect Lie. Clearly it could be used to withstand the inquisition of the Paladin ability to Detect Lie. However, blatant lies cannot be concealed and it must be cast before the false statements are made. The casting priest can always elect to allow a Detect Lie miracle to work on him at any time during this miracle's duration. These evil types can be really tricky!

name: Spiritual Mastery
description: This miracle enables the priest to summon a spirit to take control of a character or monster. Short of suicide, the victim will do the priest's bidding unhesitatingly and without question. A "controlled" priest loses the ability to use any good aligned miracles whilst "controlled". If a spiritually mastered character should increase in levels to parity with the level of the priest when he performed the spiritual mastery, the spiritual mastery still holds but the character may distort any of his master's instructions. Note that the target may still perform actions of their choice as long as these do not conflict with any orders given to them by their master. A person can only have one spiritual mastery spirit within his body at any one time. The latest spiritual mastery overrides any other, but if the previous master is of a higher level then his spiritual mastery holds. A priest may only have a number of victims up to his level of experience mastered at one time, and these should be recorded on the priest's character card. A person detects as being spiritually evil whilst spiritually mastered and has this additional spirit hovering around the body. This miracle only works on characters of less than the caster's level. It does not affect the undead.

name: Summon Wraith
description: This miracle enables a priest to summon a wraith (or wight) from the spirit plane. The ritual to summon a wraith is as follows. 1. Obtain the name of the wraith (any evil priest of suitable level can be assumed to have learnt some of these names as part of their training, so this simply requires a suitable in character name to be chosen). 2. Inscribe the name on a scroll of parchment. 3. Place the scroll within a circle of Protection from Goodly Spirits. 4. Utter the incantation while holding a ritual dagger. 5. Throw the dagger into the circle while repeating the 'By my powers...' section of the incantation. 6. The wraith will appear in the circle at the end of the incantation under the control of the summoner. The wraith is under the control of the summoner (the Summon Wraith miracle gives a weak control equivalent to a Control Wraith miracle as if cast by a

name: Suspend Life
description: Once the priest has finished incanting the verbal, he has 30 seconds in which to touch the victim of the miracle with the open palms of both hands. If he does so, then the victim falls unconscious. This is a listed stopping effect. The victim is not dead and has a very faint pulse (only discern nature of wounds or similar will tell that the character is still alive). If he receives 5 points of spiritual curing to every location he can regain consciousness. This miracle just renders its victim unconscious, it does not do any damage. This miracle does not affect the undead.

name: Summon Vampire
description: This miracle enables a priest to summon a vampire from the spirit plane. The ritual to summon a vampire is as follows: 1) A vampire name must be used (see notes under Summon Wraith for comments on these) 2) Inscribe the name on a living human/humanoid "sacrifice" (this should be phys-repped but not necessarily made visible) 3) Place the sacrifice in a circle of Protection from Spirits (good), draw in chalk and then seal the circle from the outside. 4) Cast the incantation, the vampire spirit will appear 5 minutes after the end of the incantation. It will then enter the body of the sacrifice so slaying the sacrifice. The vampire so summoned is not in any way controlled by the priest and so must be persuaded to do any task the priest wishes done. A vampire is not to be trifled with; requests to bring in the milk etc. are unlikely to be greeted with delight. Remember it could still be there when your own protection runs out! N.B. A vampire cannot be summoned in daylight.

name: Touch of Death
description: Once the priest has finished incanting the verbal, he has 30 seconds in which to touch the victim of the miracle with the open palms of both hands. If he does so, then the victim falls unconscious. This is a listed stopping effect. The victim is not dead and has a very faint pulse (only discern nature of wounds or similar will tell that the character is still alive). If he receives 5 points of spiritual curing to every location he can regain consciousness. This miracle just renders its victim unconscious, it does not do any damage. This miracle does not affect the undead. Differences/Additional rules: if used successfully the victim is instantly killed. A character (or monster) killed by this miracle cannot benefit from a Restore Life miracle, or be restored to life in any way. This DOES NOT apply should the victim have had resistances acquired post-8th to the Touch, so that they only suffer damage rather than dying outright – if this damage slays them then the death is not permanent. The priest must be standing in a Protection from Spirits (good) miracle whilst casting the miracle. After shouting the incantation the priest has 30 seconds to touch his victim with both hands, if he fails to do so, the miracle fails. If the victim has no resistance to the miracle, the priest has a 70% chance of this miracle working and an additional 10% chance for every time the victim has previously been killed. If the miracle works then the casting priest loses a level. If for any reason the miracle fails, then the priest still loses the standard 10 spirit and 10 life points, but not a level. Obviously if someone has died three times already and has no Resistance to the miracle then they automatically die. In addition if the victim lives through the miracle as a result of a successful dice roll he suffers the effects of the Suspend Life miracle instead, to which no further resistance may be applied. This miracle does not affect the undead. Information Concerning the Undead The term undead generally refers to creatures that have passed the stage of death and are somehow held in a state of continued existence, almost always by evil spiritual power. Physical undead use the corpse of a dead creature to hold the spirit, and the spirit moves the body even as it rots slowly away. Incorporeal undead are just spirits, called from the netherworld where they reside to the prime plane. There are many, many different sorts of undead, ranging from simple unintelligent spirits which can only follow basic commands right through to spirits which are at least as clever as the humans who may summon them, and can be truly powerful. Only seven sorts of undead are universally known of, and these are listed below – other sorts are less common and their natures may vary widely. Full undead all see with spirit sight, whether they also have physical eyesight as well or not. Their spirit sight is 'active', and allows them to see all spirits within the range of normal sight, as well as recognising alignment and seeing even through solid physical barriers to see spirits behind them. Fresher physical undead, or well-preserved ones, may also have physical eyes – without these, they will not be able to see creatures like elves or priests who have hidden their spirits. Even undead who have no means of transportation other than physical movement can be ordered to return to their own plane by a controlling priest, in which case their spirit immediately does so, leaving behind the body they may have had possession of. Zombie A zombie is a mindless, unintelligent undead. It can be animated from the body of a recently dead humanoid, man- sized creature. A body can generally be animated as a zombie up to 1 lunar month (28 days) after the original death of the body. A zombie can only inflict damage of Single with one handed weapons, or Double with a two handed weapon. Zombies move very slowly, generally described as 'half-speed', meaning that a competent and agile warrior should have little trouble besting one in combat. They have a dismiss level of 1. If a zombie moves more than 18' (6 paces) away from its point of animation it collapses lifeless, never to move again. Skeleton A skeleton is also an unintelligent undead. It can be animated from a well decayed body of a dead humanoid creature of man-size. It can wield weapons in the same way as zombies, albeit faster. Their resistance to sharp weapons and their ability to move at full speed makes them relatively dangerous opponents. They have a dismiss level of 2. If a skeleton moves more than 18' (6 paces) away from its point of animation it collapses lifeless, never to move again. Ghoul A ghoul is a semi-intelligent undead. It can be created from the body of a recently dead humanoid, man-sized creature. A body can be used in the creation of ghoul up to 2 weeks (14 days) after the original death of the body. They have an animal-like cunning, and an ability to think that parallels the most intelligent of wild beasts. They will sometimes hunt in packs, and often drag helpless victims off for later feeding. A ghoul cannot be created in daylight and when created, will never venture out into daylight. Unlike zombies, skeletons and mummies, ghouls eat flesh where possible. A ghoul eats dead humanoids and prefers to eat 1 man-sized body per week to survive. A ghoul will only venture from its place of creation if it is:  Controlled  Feeding  If its place of creation is outdoors A ghoul can paralyse its victims by merely striking them, the results in them being unable to move for 5 minutes. In addition its unarmed blows do Single. The paralysis is a spiritual effect. If a ghoul is able to feed regularly its body remains in relatively good repair, and they maintain their physical eyesight indefinitely. Ghouls have a dismiss level of 3. Mummy A mummy is a semi-intelligent undead. It can be created from a specially prepared body provided it is humanoid and man-sized. The embalming process generally means that mummies keep their physical eye-sight indefinitely. The special preparations are that the body must be embalmed, within 7 days of its death, in special embalming bandages and then a Cause Disease miracle must be cast upon the body some time before the Create Mummy miracle is to be cast. If Cause Disease is not cast upon the body then the mummy will not cause disease with touch. A mummy is not restricted to its point of creation and may venture into daylight. It inflicts 9 point Double with its hands only and its touch inflicts disease on its victim as per the miracle. It has a dismiss level of 4. Wraith A wraith is an intelligent purely spiritual undead. It can be summoned anywhere as long as it is not in bright light or daylight, which it will not willingly enter. A wraith does not cause damage but is able to drain levels by touch. Once summoned a wraith will not return to its plane unless:  It is dismissed  It is slain (it takes 8 spirit hits to destroy a wraith)  It has drained 6 levels  It has been controlled and ordered to return to its plane.  The miracle's duration expires, A wraith can also walk through walls and cause fear by touch, at will. When leaving a wall it suffers a two second disorientation period during which it cannot move and is invulnerable to damage, but can be targeted by non- damaging effects. A wraith cannot attack whilst any part of it is in a wall. The fear induced by a wraith causes the victim to run away from that wraith if that wraith can be seen, and is generally as per the Cause Fear miracle. Wight A wight is also an intelligent purely spiritual creature, except that its presence chills the spirit. Its touch freezes victims still for 5 minutes, alternatively it may inflict purely spiritual single by unarmed combat. It can "plane shift" between locations when reappearing it suffers a two second disorientation period during which it cannot move and cannot suffer damage (but could be effect by spiritual effects that do not damage it). Once summoned a wight will not return to its own plane unless:  It is dismissed  It is slain.  It has been controlled and ordered to depart.  The miracles duration expires. It takes 10 spirit hits to destroy a wight. Wraiths and wights are only vulnerable to spirits. They cannot perceive or effect magical creatures such as elves, elementals etc. They cannot pick up or carry anything. Vampire A vampire is an undead of almost genius intelligence. Their statistics can vary, but those summoned by the Summon Vampire miracle have the following stats: 25 Hits, and considered to have

name: Spirit Travel
description: As per the 6mp standard Blue Glyph Blink except is spiritual. I.e. allows the caster to travel up to 20' in distance or within line of sight. On arriving at destination it takes the caster 2 seconds to re-materialise, during which time he is not vulnerable to damage.

name: Spirit Walk
description: Grants the ability to walk through walls as a Minor Angel. Note: This is a Goodly miracle innate. Or Grants the ability to walk through walls as per an Abishai. Note: This is an Evil miracle innate. Or Grants Walk through Walls as Abishai, as a neutral miracle innate. Evil Wayfinder Cost Spirit Shift 50* Repel Good 20* Repel Life 35* Remove Rune Of Power 10* Paralysing Touch 55* Freezing Touch 65* Total Heal Capping Innates of the Total Heal miracle, or any other effect which duplicates or is similar to it, are limited to a maximum number per character as described below: For 1st-class Priest subclasses, Paladins and Power-Masters the maximum allowed is: 1 + BASE SPIRITS PER LEVEL (E.G. 3 FOR A WARRIOR-PRIEST) + HIGHEST POINTS THRESHOLD REACHED /2 (ROUND DOWN) So for example a Pure Priest on Table 9 may have 1 + 5 (base spirits) + 4 (9/2rounded down) =10 Total Heal effects as a maximum number of innates For all other classes the maximum allowed is: 1 (IF IN PRIEST SUBCLASS) + BASE SPIRITS PER LEVEL + HIGHEST POINTS THRESHOLD REACHED /3 (ROUND DOWN), TO A MINIMUM OF 1. So for example a Warrior on Table 12 could have 4 maximum, while if he had multiclassed to Crusading Priest he could have 6. This maximum number applies over all similar innates possessed by any character, so that they may not have more than this value between all their totally healing innates combined. If in doubt as to whether this maximum applies to a particular non-standard ability, such as a 120 tblp and loc cure, or an 'other-only Total Heal, assume that it does unless specifically clarified in writing by the system manager. This maximum number may be exceeded by one only, if the character gains such abilities from items or guild benefits, or similar exterior sources. Wound Staunch, Healing Hand and Cure Critical Wounds -type abilities are considered to be equal to half a total heal for this purpose. Innates that can be used to cast Total Heal (EG True Believer) count towards this cap if the innate is used in that way. Races Ancientfolk Details on Ancient Folk can be found in Evolution: Races, Ancient Folk may be Spirit Warriors, Warrior Priests, or Pure Priests. They have all the abilities of the class chosen as listed above, as well as their own racial abilities, but their life points are lower. They may choose to be members of a church or act as Hermits. Choice is made at

name: Holy Warding
description: todo

name: Unholy Warding
description: todo

name: Affinity with Evil
description: This miracle binds one of the priest's associated spirits to his form. The next time the priest is targeted by an evil spiritual effect (not blow), e.g. Cause Grievous, the minion spirit will interpose itself and take the effect instead. This does not affect powers used by the priest himself, but will stop even beneficial powers from other sources. Only one such miracle may be active on a priest at one time.

name: Agony of Pleasure
description: For the duration, the caster is not injured by any form of Pain effect, instead being cured half the life that the Pain would have caused. Must still roleplay other effects (for example writhing to Words of Pain).

name: Angelic Shift
description: As Spiritshift (see Neutral miracles) but is a goodly aligned miracle. Caster suffers a 2 second period of disorientation on arrival, during which he is not vulnerable to damage or effects and may not act, as per the Blink spell.

name: Animate Corpse
description: This miracle animates a corpse as an undead creature with 10 hits +1/level of the caster, to each location. Each location continues to operate until it has been individually slain, and if it suffers damage equal to twice its starting hits then the location is severed. This does mean locations do stop functioning separately. An Animate Corpse delivers 9pts of damage by unarmed combat or damage by weapon type used +1 Strength. E.g. 15pt triple with a bastard weapon wielded in two hands. An Animate Corpse has a dismiss level of 5 for controlling or dismissing.

name: Animate Greater Zombie
description: Animates a flesh-and-blood body as per Animate Zombie. However, only one corpse can be so animated, and it has hits equal to 8 +2/level of the priest. The Greater Zombie has +1 Strength, and B skill, so able to inflict Double in either hand or Triple with a two-handed weapon. It is a Level 3 undead, and can move up to 12 paces from the point of its animation.

name: Armour of the Spirit World
description: This miracle grants spiritual and physical armour class 5 to the caster for the miracles duration. This miracle does not stack with any other form of armour class. A Good or Evil version of this miracle is available as a 6sp miracle, and a 4sp version is available as a Neutral Minor Warding miracle.

name: Asylum
description: This permits a shaman to enable a willing person of the same race but of a different tribe to leave his old tribe and join the shaman’s one without any side effects. This miracle may only be cast once ever on a character. The second time around the miracle simply does not work.

name: Aversion
description: The target is held unable to approach the caster or in fact perform any act towards the caster other than speak (not cast). However this only holds while the caster continues to hold their palm outwards towards the target, and takes no other actions themselves. This miracle only affects targets of lower than or equal to the priest’s level. If the target is struck or harmed the miracle is broken. This is a Domination effect.

name: Benediction
description: todo

name: Bind Weapon Spirit
description: Infuses one normal physical weapon with a spirit, allowing it to inflict spiritual damage. Wielder must be able to utilise neutral spirit items. In own hands weapon is now +1 vs. spirits. This is a releasable miracle, and affects the undead. Good and evil versions of this miracle are available, also at 8 spirits – however, for these aligned versions, any user must be a member of own faith, and weapon only ever counts as +0 spiritual.

name: Bind Zombie Spirit
description: todo

name: Bless of Warding
description: As per standard 2sp Bless miracle in all respects except that it grants +2 SAC instead of +2 DAC. Recipient must be Goodly. Will not stack with any other Bless. This is a releasable miracle. ~ 80 ~  Miracles by Denomination The following miracles are Universal miracles but available only to priests of specific faiths. Once the miracle is acquired the Priest may learn innates of it at a cost of 10pts per spirit. Any

name: Blessed Watching
description: This advanced Bless makes the target immune to all detrimental Curses for the duration of the miracle.

name: Blessing of Battle
description: todo

name: Blessing of Life
description: Grants the recipient Fortified Spirit for the duration, meaning that they cannot be raised as any form of undead. Recipient may not be Evil. This is not a releasable miracle and does not go down when the recipient dies. It may not be cast on Undead but it may be cast on a dead body, however long dead.

name: Blessing of the Aspects of Hope I
description: todo

name: Blessing of the Aspects of Hope II
description: todo

name: Blessing of the Aspects of Hope III
description: todo

name: Borders Blessing
description: Grants a goodly recipient a stacking live to minus 12 (doubled if they are a member, including Lay Believer, of the Church of Border). Does not stack with other supernaturally generated live to minus, and if the person performs an evil act (as per Bless) this miracle is lost and they may never benefit from it again. It is not a releasable miracle Bright Lady

name: Bound Force of Power
description: One normal non-supernatural weapon wielded in two hands by the caster is imbued with spiritual power such that every blow it may now inflict Spirit Bolt rather than any normal damage. It cannot inflict normal damage and Spirit Bolt every blow; one or the other must be called only.

name: Bound Force of Stasis
description: todo

name: Bound Lesser Wings of Darkness
description: Allows the cast to cast lesser wings of darkness at will for 1 tblp with full verbal, to a maximum of 1 casting per 10 seconds for the duration of the miracle. If the caster receives any goodly spiritual healing while this miracle is active then the miracle fades. The spirits for this cannot be regained while it is active. This is a releasable miracle and can be cast by the undead. ~ 68 ~  Wither Level: 7th (8sp) Alignment: Evil Duration: 5 minutes Sphere: Major Necromancy or Major Causing Range: Touch Gesture: Touch limb Verbal: “Spirits of evil I bid thee touch this one’s limb with the weight of the world” Description: Causes the touched limb (not critical location) to wither and become unusable. Immunity to wither applies, and this can be countered by a regeneration miracle. This miracle does not affect the undead, and is a releasable miracle.

name: Bound Spirit of Causing
description: While this miracle is active the caster cannot regain the spirits used in its casting. For the duration of the miracle the caster may cast Cause Wound for 0 spirits and 0 tblp casting, at will. A full verbal is still required for each use, and all normal strictures still hold. Soul’s Hunger may not be used with these ‘free’ castings. Should the caster receive any sort of goodly curing miracle this miracle is negated.

name: Broken Heart
description: May only be used on the priest's slayer, as they die, in a manner similar to Curse. This is not a Curse however, but a dying effect. The target will be completely unable to harm any living being while they have a spirit. The only way to be freed from this effect is to receive either the forgiveness of the dead priest, or the forgiveness of the High Priest of the Sacred Heart. This miracle affects the undead. ~ 83 ~  St Michael

name: Cage Of Light
description: This miracle will only affect a spiritual undead, but regardless of its power level the undead is held stationary even if struck. This helplessness is sufficient for completing a dismissal miracle. This is a releasable miracle.

name: Calming Trance (Other)
description: As Calming Trance above, but may be cast on any non-evil spirit. This miracle does not affect the undead. This miracle and the self-version can be bought together by a Major Benediction Sphere priest for 50 points.

name: Calming Trance (Self)
description: This miracle causes goodly spirits to surround and calm the caster’s mind and spirit thus making him immune to the effects of spiritual Beguiles, Befriends, Spiritual Masteries, Fear and Voice of Powers. It is a releasable miracle, and does not affect the undead. This miracle and the (Other) version can be bought together by a Major Benediction Sphere priest for 50 points.

name: Cause Critical Wounds
description: As per the standard miracle Cause Grievous but inflicts 60 tblp and 10 to each location (20 Hits to monsters).

name: Dark Sundering
description: Target suffers 36 tblp evil spirit damage (12 Hits to monsters). Resistances to Spiritbolt apply to this damage and SAC as normal. Despite falling in the sphere of Causing Resistances to Causes do not apply to this miracle.

name: Cause Mortal Wounds
description: Must be table 11 to learn. inflicts 120/20 life (40 hits).

name: Claws of the Imbaiu
description: The caster's hands are enveloped in a shadowy ethereal force that projects purely spiritual talons from their fingers. These talons inflict 9pt Double, and the caster may use each hand in fighting with them, even if E skill is not possessed. Strength may only be used with these talons if the appropriate ability has been bought post-8th level, and weapon masteries must be acquired specifically with the claws, as they are unique in their usage. This is a releasable miracle, and affects the undead. Unity

name: Cloak of Beguilement
description: todo

name: Cloak of Fear
description: The caster is surrounded by evil spirits of fear which touch any who approach him too closely. All creatures which come within 20’ of him are affected as if by a Cause Fear miracle. This Cause Fear does not affect the undead.

name: Comfort
description: A willing target is granted Immunity to Fear, Immunity to Emotional Attacks, Insanity and Pain for the duration. However, if an evil priest receives this miracle the constant touch of the Bright Lady's love and caring is disturbing, and if the priest accepts the miracle willingly they cast miracles as if one level lower for the duration (and so may not cast 8th level miracles). Condesecration Lakh Level: 7th level (8) sp Alignment: Evil Faith: Condesecration Duration: N/A Range: 20ft radius Gesture: Raise hands Verbal: "Dark Spirits empower my voice, Lakh!" Description: This miracle is also an unholy word, and the final word must be shouted. All within range (except the caster) suffer a Cause Serious to their head. The caster benefits from a Soul’s Hunger miracle for each person effected. An individual can only be harmed by this miracle once each day. ~ 81 ~  Cult of the Eternal Vampire

name: Commanding Voice
description: As Voice of Power except that it will only work on members of the Shaman’s tribe and has no level limit for resistance purposes. The only tribe member not normally affected by this miracle is the Witchdoctor. As well as being a releasable miracle this miracle is removed by the Remove Voice of Power miracle.

name: Communication with the Gods
description: As per Greater Communication but no limit to the number of questions asked and the spirits may respond to an individual question with more than just seven words. Questions must be asked in a measured and respectful manner, or no response will be gained. The caster may choose to have all questions be only regarding one specific area, in which case the divination lasts 5 minutes, or simply answering any questions they desire, in which case the duration is only two minutes but the miracle becomes far more versatile.

name: Converse With Spirit
description: As per Talk To Spirits in all respects, including which spirits will respond truthfully but as many questions may be asked as required for duration.

name: Cure Critical
description: heals 60 tblp damage and 60 pts of locational damage, in a similar manner to Heal. Under no circumstances can this miracle heal more than 72 points of damage, ever. This miracle does not affect the undead.

name: Cure Poison
description: The miracle causes all non-magical poisons within the targets system that have not yet “kicked in” to be purged and become ineffective. This miracle does not affect the undead.

name: Curse Of Death
description: todo

name: Curse Of Pain
description: Any damage suffered by the target is increased by 25% before armour and other damage reductions. For monsters reduce their hits by 1/4 for the duration. The 25% increase in damage is unlike cold rage or berserk rage abilities in that rages are deducted after all armour calculations, whereas this curse is before all armour calculations. The effect of multiple castings of this miracle is not cumulative and is removed by a single bless. This miracle does not affect the undead. ~ 78 ~  Curse Of Death Level: 6sp Alignment: Evil Duration: Until blessed or 15 mins Sphere: Witchcraft Range: 20’ Gesture: Point at target Verbal: “By my evil spirits I curse thee to die!” Description: As Voice of Power with the command of “Die!” but affects up to and including levels of resistance equal to the caster’s level, and is only removed by the death of the caster, the Remove Voice of Power miracle, or by a Bless or the duration expires. This miracle does not affect the undead.

name: Curse Of Unhealing
description: This miracle is only removed by a bless from a Witch, Hospitaller or Paladin or 2 blesses from a normal 8th level goodly priest and causes spiritual healing rates for the afflicted character to be greatly reduced as follows: Cure Wound Cures 3/3 Cure Serious Cures 6/6 Cure Disease Slows to 1/2 rate Heal Cures 18/18 Cure Critical Cures 24/4 to locs Total Heal Cures 36/36 If the character has a reduced effect from curing for any other reason this applies after the modifier listed above and is an extension of that listed above. If a character receives an increased benefit from curing abilities this is negated whilst the miracle is active upon him, in addition to the modifiers listed above! All other healing miracles only heal 1/2 of what they would normally cure. Other sources of healing work at normal rate including Empathic Healing. An 8th level Witch who possesses this miracle may elect to use it as their dying curse in which case it may only be removed by an 8th level goodly Witch and until that point is permanent in duration. If used as a dying curse suffix the verbal with “...Forever!”. Should the Witch spend 25 points on Table 7 the dying curse will then need 3 different goodly witches to each cast a Bless before it is removed.

name: Curse Of Unliving
description: This miracle reduces the restore life percentage of the victim by 10% permanently, if the target is not immune to curses. This lost percentage can only be regained if the character is blessed by a good witch. An 8th level Witch who possesses this miracle may elect to use it as her dying curse in which case it may only be removed by an 8th level goodly Witch and until that point is permanent in duration. If used as a dying curse suffix the verbal with “...Forever!”. Should the Witch spend 25 points on Table 7 the dying curse will then need 3 different goodly witches to each cast a Bless before it is removed. This miracle does not stack with itself. i.e. a victim may never be suffering more than 10% restore life chance loss from it at any given time. This miracle does not affect the undead. ~ 79 ~  Witchcraft ~ Goodly

name: Curse To Fumble
description: The target becomes unable to manipulate objects with his hands to the degree that nothing may be held within them, though unarmed combat may still be used with a penalty of -1 maximum damage grade. Spells and miracles may still be cast without difficulty.

name: Curse To Smell
description: This afflicts the target with a spiritual odour only discernible by his allies. This causes the loss of 1 point of dexterity armour class as eyes water and the senses are assailed, affecting all those within line of sight of or 100’ of the target. This miracle does not actually cause any disbenefit for the target who has been so cursed, other than his allies not being very keen to be near him! Should a character within the radius make use of the Sniff or Locational Sniff ability the acrid smell disrupts further use of the Sniff ability for that adventure. If the character uses a perfume or scent potion to try and negate the smell it mixes in such a fashion that he is also now affected by the miracle. If the target was not Immune to Curses then he begins to smell affecting those indicated above. If one of the secondary victims listed above is immune to curses then they still suffer the penalties, even if an Elf, Faerie, Drave or similar spirit less being, immunity to olfactory attacks is required.

name: Curse to Trip
description: The target trips over and falls to the ground. The target needs to be moving but does not require an object to ‘trip’ over.

name: Death Rites
description: This miracle must be cast within 15minutes of the targets death. It grants the target Fortified Spirit and Immunity to all ‘Slayer’ type effects. They also gain the benefits of ‘Fated Hero’ meaning that they will only lose 10% res chance if ressed off-dungeon. Dunatis

name: Degeneration
description: The target ceases to be able to use any form of healing Regeneration for the duration (e.g. a Troll could not regen). This is not a releasable miracle, and resistances to Degeneration reduce the duration.

name: Devour the Spirit
description: Must be able to cast Wraith’s Touch. Causes the touched target to lose 8 levels, as per the wraith’s touch miracle. Immunity to level drain applies. This does effect the undead. This miracle costs a level to cast, and reductions in level loss may be purchased as per reductions in level loss to Touch of Death. Those that have multiraced Vampire or Wraith may learn this as a minor necromancy miracle. A priest must be table 8 to cast this miracle.

name: Diminish Spirit
description: This miracle causes the target to lose 12 tblp and 4 locational life points, which cannot be regained until the miracle expires. This miracle is not cumulative with itself. This loss of life points is not affected by Spiritual Armour Class or other damage reductions. If this miracle is cast upon a target with the Enhance Spirit miracle active on it then both miracles are cancelled and vice versa.

name: Dismiss Level 10 Undead
description: As Dismiss Vampire but will affect up to level 10 undead. In order to acquire this miracle must first possess Dismiss Level 9. Note: Dismiss Levels 7 to 10 may be purchased as a single ability for 225pts. ~ 50 ~  Neutral Miracles 1st Level Neutral Advanced Miracles

name: Dismiss Level 7 Undead
description: As Dismiss Vampire but will affect up to level 7 undead.

name: Dismiss Level 8 Undead
description: As Dismiss Vampire but will affect up to level 8 undead. In order to acquire this miracle must first possess Dismiss Level 7. ~ 49 ~  Dismiss Level 9 Undead Level: 8th (12sp) Alignment: Good Duration: Until dismissed Sphere: Major Dismissal Range: 10’ Gesture: Open palm towards target Verbal: “Spirit of... (Dismiss Name)... I dismiss thee hence.” Description: As Dismiss Vampire but will affect up to level 9 undead. In order to acquire this miracle must first possess Dismiss Level 8.

name: Dismiss Level 9 Undead
description: todo

name: Divine Invocation
description: The caster receives a 9pt reduction against all spiritual blows struck against him for the duration. This is a numerical damage reduction, and does not stack with any other numerical reduction. The reduction is reduced to 6pts if the caster strikes anything themselves – they may cast miracles however.

name: Empower Spirit
description: Acts as per an enhanced spirit, but note the duration. This is a releasable miracle, fades on the recipient’s death, and does not affect the undead.

name: Enhance Spirit
description: This miracle grants the target +12/4 life for the duration of the miracle. This life functions exactly as if they were normal life points for the target. Effects such as permanent damage are taken from this temporary life first, so possibly 'vanishing' at the end of the duration. Life from this miracle is non-stacking with life from any other miracle or spell, although it will stack with abilities such as Adrenal Surge. It is a releasable miracle. It does not affect the undead.

name: Enhanced Stasis
description: As the 2sp standard miracle Stasis but works on characters of level equal to or below the caster’s. This miracle does not affect the undead.

name: Enslaved Spirit
description: This miracle places a spirit within a humanoid shape. This can be a corpse, or it can be a stone or metal figure crafted for the purpose. However, such crafting is usually impractical during “Time-In” due to the labour and time required – it might be possible however to animate a statue or similar which was otherwise unmoving. This miracle can never be used on any form of animate creature, whether living, golem or undead. The animated form is an entirely mindless unintelligent spirit bound to do nothing but obey the caster’s will, and will follow his commands to the letter, but take no other acts, even in defence of itself. It is considered to have 2 grades of strength. It has 30 hits per location, plus an additional 2 hits for each extra spirit spent during its creation. It moves at only ¾ speed, and can wield any weapon given it or use unarmed at base damage, plus strength. Each location functions independently of every other. If the animation is made from a stone or metal statue, it gains ½ effect all damage except for purely spiritual. Under no circumstances can it be healed, and a Spiritual Freedom will destroy it. It is considered to have 8th level resistances. Although the miracle is permanent, the spirits used cannot be regained while the miracle is active, so most priests will release the miracle once the spirit has served its purpose. ~ 71 ~  Incarna Mortis Level: 8th (10sp) Alignment: Evil Duration: 15 minutes Sphere: Major Necromancy Range: 20’ Gesture: Point at target Verbal: “Spirits of the dead cluster around (him / her) with the touch of the grave.” Description: The target is surrounded by undead spirits plucking at their spirit. This feels extremely uncomfortable, and has the additional side effect of making the target immune to all miracles to which undead are immune. They now discern as (but are not actually) a level 6 type unknown (Dismiss name “Incarna Mortis”) – if this spirit is dismissed the miracle is removed but, if not, at the end of the duration the target suffers a Paralysis, Fear, Disease, Freeze and Level Drain simultaneously, as undead touch effects. Should resistance (half-effect) be possessed to this miracle, the duration is halved and the touch effects are never triggered on the victim. This miracle does not affect the undead. Fortified Spirit grants immunity to this miracle, unless willing.

name: Extend Control
description: The duration of a control undead miracle or raise, create, summon undead miracle is raised to 30 minutes for undead up to 4th level or 15 minutes for undead of 5th level and above. ~ 61 ~  Bind Zombie Spirit Level: 3sp Alignment: Evil Duration: 5 minutes Sphere: Minor Necromancy Range: Self Gesture: Both hands touch head Verbal: "Spirit of zombie I bind thee to my body, to do as I command!" Description: The caster summons the spirit which would normally animate a zombie into his own body. The effect of this is that the zombie spirit is the outer layer around the priest's own spirit. The priest will discern as a Level 1 Zombie, even if they would normally discern as some other sort of undead, and any effect targeted against undead, such as a dismiss miracle or a Hand of Purity will only destroy the zombie spirit, leaving the priest untouched. The disadvantage to this state is that the caster will be repelled by repel undead and such, and will be unable to cross protections and wards which could not be crossed by a standard zombie. This miracle can be used by the undead.

name: Focussed Spirit Bolt
description: Acts as per a spirit bolt but also inflicts damage to one chosen location.

name: Force of Will
description: This miracle makes the next level-based miracle cast by the priest act at one level higher.

name: Foul Touch
description: May be cast on any full undead (not just the subject of an Animate Life). The target undead now inflicts a Foul Touch of equal to its dismiss level, every blow (as per points tables ability). This damage cannot stack above Quad, as normal. Foul Touch inflicts 1 Hit to monsters for every 3 pts or part thereof. It is spiritual damage. This miracle costs 40pts to buy.

name: Freezing Touch
description: This miracle grants the priest the ability to freeze a single target as though the target was touched by a Wight. The miracle once incanted stays on the caster’s weapon hand for 30 seconds or until discharged. This is not considered an undead touch effect. In order to have this miracle on his miracle list the priest must also have the Summon Wraith / Wight miracle. ~ 64 ~  Undead Alacrity Level: 5sp Alignment: Evil Duration: 15 minutes Sphere: Major Necromancy Range: Touch Gesture: Touch target Verbal: "Dark Spirits of the Netherworld grant this creature thy watching!" Description: This miracle only affects Undead. If the creature previously had a movement restriction, e.g. Zombie half speed, it is removed. If they did not then they gain +1 weapon mastery. They additionally gain 6HTK, if a player character +18tblp. This extra life will stack with any other temp life, bar itself. 6th Level Evil Advanced Miracles

name: Greater Bless
description: As per standard 3sp Bless miracle in all respects except it grants +3 DAC instead of +2. Recipient must be Goodly. Will not stack with any other Bless. This is a releasable miracle.

name: Greater Word of Recall
description: All priests of the church of the caster are returned to their temple if they are within 1 mile of the casting Priest. Each Priest present when returned to the Temple loses all spiritual powers for the remainder of the day should they leave the temple. The return point is shielded by the god to prevent the priests being interfered with or even contacted during this time. If this miracle is cast by a Shaman allows him to take his entire tribe using the verbal: “May the totems return us to our home, Greater Word of Recall.” A Good or Evil version of this miracle is available also as an 8th (14sp) miracle. For 50pts Tb 8: This miracle may now be used to affect any Lay Believers of the Church that possess a spirit.

name: Hand Of Purity
description: This miracle functions in all manners as per the Tables ability Hand of Purity i.e. This miracle destroys 1 undead by touch with the Caster suffering 10 tblp per level of the undead. If the caster dies, he dies perm. This Damage may not be reduced by use of “No Damage Casting” abilities but the normal casting damage for spirits expended may be resisted as normal. Once the verbal is incanted the caster has 30 seconds to touch an undead. In order to acquire this miracle, the priest must first possess Dismiss Level 10.

name: Healing Hand
description: This miracle enables the caster to completely heal one location of any damage that it has taken, if 30 seconds of calm preparation are spent with the recipient first (Cf. Total Heal). It will also heal the same amount of TBLP that has been lost on the location healed. On a creature with only half a spirit this miracle will not cure more than 36pts of damage. If the miracle is not prepared as above, it cures only 36 points of damage, or 18 on a creature with half a spirit. This miracle does not affect the undead.

name: Holy Ground
description: For the duration of this miracle any undead within its range count as one level lower for the purpose of dismissal, destruction and warding effects.

name: Identify Spirit
description: Only usable on inanimate spirits such as artefacts or wards – not on any sort of creature, even undead. The caster is made aware immediately of all (spiritual) properties of the spirit. In the case of an item of power, this would mean exactly what powers it had and how it was activated. In the case of a ward, this would mean exactly what effects the ward had and how it was triggered and deactivated. An object which also has magical or other nonspiritual properties will reveal only the spiritual ones, revealing nothing about other aspects of its power.

name: Incarna Mortis
description: todo

name: Insight of the Gods
description: Must be able to cast Commune with the Gods. Allows the caster to ask a single question of a communication miracle once per 15 minutes. The spirits for the miracle cannot be regained while it is active.

name: Instant Regeneration
description: This acts as the 6sp standard miracle Regeneration in all respects except that it is instant in effect and cures the limb to full and an amount of tblp equal to the location's value (e.g. has 30 per location, is restored 30 tblp – not 60). This miracle does not affect the undead. ~ 48 ~  Blessing of Battle Level: 7th (8sp) Alignment: Good Duration: 5 minutes Sphere: Major Benediction Range: Touch Gesture: Touch targets chest from the front (heart area) Verbal: “May the spirits of light fill your soul with their power. Go forth to purge the darkness from this world” Description: This infuses the recipient, who must be goodly, with the power of the spirits of light. This grants them the benefits of a Holy Fury (as per Paladin ability), being + 12/4 life, 25% rage vs. evil, + 1 max damage vs. evil, and + 1 strength (above current max). This is a releasable miracle and life from this miracle DOES stack with enhanced spirit.

name: Interdiction
description: The caster must have observed the target performing one of the following overtly good or evil acts in order to cast this miracle upon them:  Casting a Restore Life miracle or Casting a Touch of Death miracle  Curing a non party member or Stealing another’s property  Slaying an evil party member or Slaying a goodly party member  Use of any Paladinic Spiritual power or Use of any Unholy Champion’s Spiritual power This is by no means a complete use of overt acts of good or evil but represents the limits for this miracle. The target of this miracle will no longer benefit from miracles cast upon him, suffers twice normal effect from miracles cast by priests of the opposite alignment and if he dies whilst this miracle is active upon him will gain no benefit from owning a returner or having a dying effect. This miracle may only be used by the Grey Warden in part of his balance keeping operation. i.e. if the party consists of 5 good characters, the Grey Warden and 3 evil characters he will not use it upon the evil characters, only the good ones. If the miracle is being cast upon an NPC or monster, then the alignment of the mission with regards to its aims should be determined by the referee in advance; on a 'Goodly' mission the miracle may only be cast on Goodly NPC’s, and the converse for Evil. If the mission is deemed 'Neutral' by the referee then the Grey Warden may use his own judgement as to when the casting of this miracle is appropriate. This miracle affects the undead. ~ 76 ~  Shamanic Miracles These miracles may only be acquired by a Shaman of a tribe, they may not be bought by any other form of Priest.

name: Invoke Evil
description: This miracle costs the caster 10% of his Restore to Life chance, and as such this means that this miracle may only be cast by characters or NPCs with vitae! As referees should be aware, few NPCs have restore to life chance, and are likely to have less than PCs at any rate, so this miracle should be very rarely if ever used by NPCs. This miracle causes the target to suffer 36 tblp and 6 to each location. This damage is generated from the traces of evil within each person, and as such Spiritual Armour Class and Resistance to Causing Miracles have no effect upon this miracle. In addition the target suffers a no level limit Halt with a duration of 30 seconds.

name: Judgement
description: All within the radius are weighed up by the spirits of balance. Whichever alignment of Good and Evil is found to be predominant (i.e. whichever there is more of) among the spirits of the creatures in the area (not associated spirits, items, etc), all those of that alignment suffer a neutrally aligned Diminish Spirit and Curse. Immunity to either grants immunity to that effect. This miracle and its results affect the undead.

name: Kneel before the Master
description: This miracle forces the target to drop to their knees if they are of lower level than the caster. This is a Domination Effect, and is removed by a Spiritual Freedom but immunity to Spiritual Mastery does not apply. The target cannot leave their knees for the duration, although they may otherwise act freely. ~ 62 ~  Paralysing Touch Level: 4sp Alignment: Evil Duration: 5 minutes Sphere: Minor Necromancy Range: Touch Gesture: Touch Target Verbal: “By these evil spirits may I paralyse thee...” Description: This miracle grants the priest the ability to paralyse a single target as thought the target had been touched by a ghoul, this touch will only inflict damage if the priest casting the miracle has the skill of unarmed combat. The miracle once incanted stays on the caster’s weapon hand for 30 seconds or until discharged. This is not considered an undead touch effect. In order to have this miracle on his miracle list the priest must also have the miracle of Create Ghoul.

name: Knowledge of the Gods
description: Must be able to cast Insight of the Gods. Allows the caster to ask a single question of a greater communication miracle once per 15 minutes. The spirits for the miracle cannot be regained. Evil Miracles These miracles may be only cast by a character that is CN, CE, NE or LE in alignment and possesses spirit points which may be used to cast evil miracles. 1st Level Evil Advanced Miracles

name: Lakh
description: This miracle is also an unholy word, and the final word must be shouted. All within range (except the caster) suffer a Cause Serious to their head. The caster benefits from a Soul’s Hunger miracle for each person affected. An individual can only be harmed by this miracle once each day.

name: Lesser Wings of Darkness
description: This miracle will allow the caster to turn a standard Causing tree miracle up to 7th level [8spirits] that they currently have ‘hanging’ into a ranged attack. It is not possible to use Soul’s Hunger with any of the Wings of Darkness miracles. This miracle may be learnt as a Universal Miracle for 3 spirits.

name: Light Of Purity
description: todo

name: Major Blessing
description: This miracle functions as Bless in all ways, except that it is much more powerful, granting 6 points of Dexterity AC for the duration. This AC of course does not stack with that from other Blesses, Watchings or similar. Witches may learn this as a Minor Benediction miracle.

name: Major Prayer
description: Acts as a single question from a Greater Communication miracle. ~ 53 ~ Range: Self  Ward Against the Traveller Level: 4sp Alignment: Neutral Duration: 15 minutes Sphere: Major Warding Range: As Prot Gesture: As protection from spirits. Verbal: “Spirits of protection I invoke thee permit not those travelling the worlds to pass.” Description: This acts as per a stronghold in all ways, including the need for the caster to remain inside it. However rather than stopping a specific alignment it instead bars against anyone with a spirit that is using supernatural means of transport (shifting, walking through walls/floors etc.) from crossing it.

name: Mark Of The Totem
description: The recipient of the casting of this miracle gains +6/2 life points per tribe member standing around him at the time the miracle is cast. If more than 3 tribe members are standing around him when it is cast he gains +1 DAC, +1 SAC and +1 PAC. If more than 9 tribe members are standing around him when it is cast he also gains immunity to listed stopping effects for duration. “Standing around him” means within 20’ and focusing their attention on the casting of the miracle.

name: Mass Halt
description: Causes everyone (allies and foes) within the radius to suffer a Halt miracle affecting those lower than the caster’s level. This does not affect the undead. 5th Level Neutral Advanced Miracles

name: Spirit Travel
description: As per the 6mp standard Blue Glyph Blink except is spiritual. I.e. allows the caster to travel up to 20’ in distance or within line of sight. On arriving at destination it takes the caster 2 seconds to re-materialise, during which time he is not vulnerable to damage.

name: Spirit Walk
description: Grants the ability to walk through walls as a Minor Angel. Note: This is a Goodly miracle innate. Or Grants the ability to walk through walls as per an Abishai. Note: This is an Evil miracle innate. Or Grants Walk through Walls as Abishai, as a neutral miracle innate. ~ 38 ~  Total Heal Capping Innates of the Total Heal miracle, or any other effect which duplicates or is similar to it, are limited to a maximum number per character as described below: For 1st-class Priest subclasses, Paladins and Power-Masters the maximum allowed is: 1 + BASE SPIRITS PER LEVEL (E.G. 3 FOR A WARRIOR-PRIEST) + HIGHEST POINTS THRESHOLD REACHED /2 (ROUND DOWN) So for example a Pure Priest on Table 9 may have 1 + 5 (base spirits) + 4 (9/2rounded down) =10 Total Heal effects as a maximum number of innates For all other classes the maximum allowed is: 1 (IF IN PRIEST SUBCLASS) + BASE SPIRITS PER LEVEL + HIGHEST POINTS THRESHOLD REACHED /3 (ROUND DOWN), TO A MINIMUM OF 1. So for example a Warrior on Table 12 could have 4 maximum, while if he had multiclassed to Crusading Priest he could have 6. This maximum number applies over all similar innates possessed by any character, so that they may not have more than this value between all their totally healing innates combined. If in doubt as to whether this maximum applies to a particular non-standard ability, such as a 120 tblp and loc cure, or an ‘other-only Total Heal, assume that it does unless specifically clarified in writing by the system manager. This maximum number may be exceeded by one only, if the character gains such abilities from items or guild benefits, or similar exterior sources. Wound Staunch, Healing Hand and Cure Critical Wounds -type abilities are considered to be equal to half a total heal for this purpose. Innates that can be used to cast Total Heal (EG True Believer) count towards this cap if the innate is used in that way. ~ 39 ~  Races Ancientfolk Details on Ancient Folk can be found in Evolution: Races, Ancient Folk may be Spirit Warriors, Warrior Priests, or Pure Priests. They have all the abilities of the class chosen as listed above, as well as their own racial abilities, but their life points are lower. They may choose to be members of a church or act as Hermits. Choice is made at 1st level. Silverfolk As described in Evolution: Races, Silverfolk may be Spirit Warriors, Warrior Priests, Hermit or Pure Priests. They have all the abilities of the class chosen as listed above, as well their own racial abilities, but their life points are lower. They may join churches or choose to act as per Hermits. Choice is made at 1st level. Elysians As described in the Evolution: Races, Elysians may be Pure Priests or Hospitallers. They have all the abilities of the class as listed above, as well their own racial abilities, but their life points are lower. Elysian Vivomancers are detailed within the Wizards Grimoire book. Dwarves Dwarves may be Warrior-Priests (only). However they gain all dwarven racial benefits, and their life points are calculated as warrior-priest for tblp, but at half their tblp (rounded up) per location - so that at 8th level, with 39 tblp, they have 20 per location. They may join churches as normal. Half-Elves Half-Elves may be any of the basic priest classes, but they are greatly disadvantaged by their heritage; due to their mixed parentage, they have only half a spirit, so taking only half-effect from all spiritual powers, whether beneficial or detrimental. They gain only half the number of spirits that their Human counterparts would have (round up by level, so that a half-elven warrior-priest gains 2 spirits per level), may not cast 8th level miracles, and pay double for all priestly abilities post-8th! Half-Elves do not make talented priests. They may join churches. Alfar Alfar may be Pure Priests, Spiritual Warriors, as described in Evolution: Races. In this case their class stats are identical to those of a half-elven pure priest. May join churches or act as hermits – choice is made at 1st level. ~ 40 ~  Spheres of Spirituality Some of the miracles listed are divided into Spheres. A Sphere will be described as being either Major or Minor and related to a specific tree. A priest may acquire any miracle of any Minor Sphere provided that he is of the relevant alignment. Alternatively he may choose to specialise, selecting Primary and Secondary Spheres. In this case, the priest may learn Major miracles of his Primary Sphere, Minor miracles in his Secondary Sphere but no other Sphere-based miracles. Standard miracles are universally accessible to Priests of the correct alignment and are hence non Sphere based. It costs 40pts on Table 1 to specialise as described above. Note: It is not possible to possess the Post 8th ability Devotion to a tree other than that in which the Priest has bought Primary Sphere or vice versa, if the Priest has bought Devotion he may only buy Primary Sphere in the tree to which he is devoted. On Table 10, a priest may choose either to upgrade his Secondary Sphere so that he may cast Major miracles of that Sphere, for +60 pts, or acquire a Tertiary Sphere from which he may learn Minor miracles, for +40 pts (not both). Non-weapon using priests that have not left the priest bracket may learn an additional minor Sphere on table 7 for 40 points, and may upgrade this to a major Sphere on table 11 for a further 40 points. Here follows a list of the different Spheres of miracles currently available and what they relate to: Sphere Type Universal Castable by any Healing Curative miracles Causing Causing miracles Dismissal Anti-Undead Necromancy Pro-Undead Communication Informational Dominion Commanding Benediction Aid Force Direct power Warding Protections Shamanic * Shamans only Witchcraft * Witches only Balance * “Grey Wardens” Universal: Miracles in this Sphere are universally castable and do not fall into any specific Sphere and as such are castable by any priest, of the correct alignment, who wishes to acquire them regardless of their own speciality. *These are not actual Spheres in themselves but represent miracles only available to a certain class of Priest. They are considered to be exactly as Universal miracles but only castable by that class and do not affect the Sphere that that Priest may specialise in an. Some miracles may be appropriate to more than one Sphere and will be marked as such. The ‘standard’ 1st-8th miracles listed earlier in this book are considered Universal because although many of them are clearly fitting to one Sphere it is possible for anyone of the appropriate alignment to acquire the ability to cast them. ~ 41 ~  Advanced Miracles What follows is a list of priestly miracles which are more specialised and less easily acquired than the standard miracles listed above. These miracles may be purchased either with points post 8th, placed upon any new miracle list (following the restrictions set out in list construction above), or learnt from Scriptures of the Faith. None of these miracles appear on any of the trees for the purpose of free 7th or 8th level miracles during the construction of a miracle list. Any of these miracles which do not affect the undead are specifically marked as such. Goodly Miracles 2nd Level Goodly Advanced Miracles

name: Netherworld's Embrace
description: No undead will attack the caster unless they are directly controlled to, and will do so as the last option. If the caster attacks/acts directly against (e.g. controls a Ghoul Generator to leave, or similar) undead then this miracle ends instantly. It is not a releasable miracle.

name: Pact of Blood
description: This miracle ‘hangs’ on the hands of the caster for 30 seconds, in the same manner as causing miracles. While under the effect of this miracle each time the target draws the blood of a spiritual target (hits a flesh-and-blood creature with a sharp weapon for the first time) they are struck by the drawn evil spirits, taking 36/6 evil spiritual damage to which SAC applies (12 Hits to monsters). This damage is taken each time a new flesh-and-blood target is struck after the miracle becomes active, but once taken from a given creature there is no further penalty for striking that creature again. This miracle does not affect the undead.

name: Paralysing Touch
description: Paralyse a single target as thought the target had been touched by a ghoul, this touch will only inflict damage if the priest casting the miracle has the skill of unarmed combat.
