The miracle once incanted stays on the caster’s weapon hand for 30 seconds or until discharged. This is not considered an undead touch effect

name: Passive Heal
description: This miracle acts as a receptacle for a Heal miracle and is useless until one is cast into it. At this point it becomes active and stores the Heal miracle until one of the following conditions are met:  One of the targets’ locations falls below 1 life point.  The target is injured 36 tblp or more. This miracle does not affect the undead.

name: Passive Total Heal
description: Must be able to cast passive heal. This acts in a similar manner to a passive heal except any healing Sphere/tree miracle that cures damage can be placed in it. The miracle triggers when a critical location goes below 1 point, or the person falls to 1 (or less) tblp. If the miracle’s duration expires then the healing is wasted. The maximum that can be healed by the triggered healing is 72 points of damage (cf. an Un-prepped Total heal). ~ 47 ~  Ward against the Dead Level: 6sp Alignment: Good Sphere: Major Dismissal Duration: 5 minutes Range: Touch Gesture: Touch targets head Verbal: “Spirits of light ward this one against the touch of the undead” Description: Grants the recipient immunity to undead touch effects for the duration. This is a releasable miracle. 7th Level Goodly Advanced Miracles

name: Possession
description: This miracle possesses the target in a similar way to Spiritual Mastery, but more fully. It affects targets of equal to the caster’s level and below, and the target is completely unable to perform any act whatsoever other than those ordered by the caster. The possession is full enough that absolutely any command will be obeyed, even completely suicidal ones, but the target will be unable to use any abilities which require conscious thought, such as casting spells, miracles or neuronics. However they gain +1 stacking strength for the duration, without maximum. This is a Domination effect and Immunity to Spiritual Mastery grants immunity. Spiritual Freedom will also remove the effects. The priestly ability to Discern Spiritual Mastery will reveal the presence of this miracle. This miracle does not affect the undead.

name: Power of the Throne
description: Grants the recipient Divine Guidance and immunity to lack of faith or similar for the duration. A priest of Glass can always cast this miracle, even if they do not have Divine Guidance themselves. This miracle does not, oddly, function on Talthar priests. Lady of the Stars

name: Protection from All Spirits
description: As Protection from Spirits, except that it will keep out spirits of any alignment, level-based as normal. ~ 54 ~  Warding Rune of Transgression Level: 5sp Alignment: Neutral Duration: 15 mins Sphere: Major Warding Range: - Gesture: Inscribe rune Verbal: “Spirit of power I bind thee to this rune I now inscribe. Let any that seek passage suffer the consequences of their transgression.” Description: This miracle is a very specific form of a Rune of Power. The form the rune must take is the same as that for a Rune of Power, with a spirit rune ‘W’ in the centre of the triangle. It is triggered in all ways as a Rune of Transgression is, except that the caster cannot choose to allow anyone passage – even the caster himself will trigger it if he passes the door or entrance-way it wards. The victim of the miracle suffers 30 tblp of spiritual damage, as if they had crossed a Minor Ward of Power – however this is the only effect of the rune. This miracle does affect the undead, unlike normal runes of power. Note the reduced duration of the miracle in comparison with other runes. Immunity to Rune of Power means that the rune is not triggered by that person – ½ Damage from Wards of Power does halve the damage received.

name: Protection From Neutral Spirits
description: This acts in all ways as the 3sp standard miracle Protection From Spirits except that it only works against neutral targets. This miracle is level based in the same manner as the Protection From Spirits miracle.

name: Pure Force
description: Negates any one purely spiritual effect (not blow) directed at the caster. Must be called within 2 seconds of the attack. It is possible to use this to cross a ward or protection which would otherwise block the caster’s passage, as long as it is purely spiritual.

name: Purification
description: This miracle has the power to dismiss and remove the taint that an undead has left in a body allowing it to then benefit from a Restore Life miracle or similar. Casting this miracle causes the Priest to lose a full level. As noted above, Holy Water is required, to lightly sprinkle over target's body. In order to acquire this miracle as a Major Dismissal must first possess Dismiss Level 9 undead.

name: Questioning Spirits
description: This miracle allows the caster to ask as many questions as per Communication as desired within the duration of the miracle. The speed and pace of the questioning should remain respectful of the all knowing spirits, else the miracle may fail.

name: Renewal
description: The target receives a cure serious wounds miracle every minute for the duration as long as they remain at rest in the same general location that it is cast. ~ 44 ~  Shield Blessing Level: 4sp Alignment: Good Duration: 24 hours Sphere: Major Benediction Range: Touch Gesture: Touch the shield Verbal: “Spirits of light I call upon thee to bless and ward this shield here” Description: This miracles acts as per a bless on a shield, but additionally allows it to parry purely spiritual weapon blows. 5th Level Goodly Advanced Miracles

name: Repel Evil Spirits
description: As per the Paladinic ability (Unholy Champions are not immune), this throws all evil spirits within range back 20’.

name: Repel Good Spirits
description: As per the Unholy Champion ability, repelling the targets in the front arc of the caster 20’. This miracle is cheaper than the converse Goodly miracle as Evil spirits lend themselves more readily to such tasks.

name: Repel Life
description: As per Repel Undead but affects the living instead. By definition, this miracle does not affect the undead.

name: Restoration
description: This miracle must be cast upon a person who has been level drained within the course of the adventure in which they were drained. When it is cast it restores one level lost to evil spiritual level drain effects (not selfinflicted). Additional levels may be restored at the cost of 1sp each per lost level at the time of casting.

name: Reveal Undead Name
description: The Caster is told the full true dismiss/control name of the indicated Undead. A Neutral version of this miracle is available as a 4sp miracle. An Evil version of this miracle is available as a 5sp miracle. ~ 45 ~  Cure Critical Level: 5sp Alignment: Good Duration: Instant Sphere: Minor Healing Range: Touch Gesture: Palms on target head Verbal: “I call upon the spirits of light to staunch these mortal wounds and reforge this shattered body... Cure Critical Wounds!” Description: This miracle heals 60 tblp damage and 60 pts of locational damage, in a similar manner to Heal. Under no circumstances can this miracle heal more than 72 points of damage, ever. This miracle does not affect the undead. 6th Level Goodly Advanced Miracles

name: Righteous Aura
description: The priest's spirit is concentrated more fully in opposition of undead spirits. For the duration, the priest may not cast any miracle except directly against undead. However, any undead creature of level 5 or below which touches or is touched by the priest is destroyed instantly, costing the priest 3 tblp per level of the undead. Undead of levels greater than 6th take 12 tblp (4 hits) of goodly spiritual damage for each touch. This is a releasable miracle, and does affect the undead. Sacred Heart

name: Rite of the Bane God
description: To cast this miracle the priest needs a 'focus' of his faith, of significant size; this may be an altar, or a banner with his religious symbol, or similar. This must be Cursed before the rite begins. During the casting he must spend 15 minutes performing appropriate ritual acts to please his deity, with only the start and final incantations fixed. It is permissible during this period to cast appropriate Evil miracles - their cost is taken from the total cost of the rite. These miracles must be targeted on/centred on the focus - not a Beguile on another party-member, for example. At the end of the rite, a pall falls across every spirit within the radius, as dark powers watch. This feeling of foreboding is strong enough that any Priest within the radius is aware that there is an evil presence here. All Causing miracles cast within the area inflict 1pt of permanent damage to tblp and loc for each 6 pts they normally inflict - so that a Cause Wound inflicts 6 tblp and loc, of which 1pt is permanent and cannot be cured. Resistance to Cause miracles halves the amount of permanent damage (round up). Resisted TODs and Suspend Lifes inflict permanent harm in the same way, and unresisted their effects cannot be removed for the duration - so that a Suspend Life'd target is not brought round by a Heal miracle. The effects of Cause Disease are not restored when the miracle is removed - so that if a sufferer of a disease has reached the stage where they are no longer conscious, curing the disease only prevents further progression - the victim remains unconscious. This damage (or other effect) fades only after a full day's rest, or may be healed if the focus of the rite is desecrated. To disrupt the rite, its focus must first be freed from the Curse, either with a Bless or by slaying the caster, and then the focus either destroyed physically or moved outside the radius of the rite. This is not a releasable miracle, and does affect the undead. ~ 74 ~  Good or Evil Miracles These miracles may be acquired as either a goodly aligned miracle or as an evilly aligned miracle but not as a neutral miracle. Neutral priests cannot acquire these miracles unless specifically stated in the miracle’s description that they may.

name: Rite of the Bright God
description: To cast this miracle the priest needs a 'focus' of his faith, of significant size; this may be an altar, or a banner with his religious symbol, or similar. This must be Blessed before the rite begins. During the casting he must spend 15 minutes performing appropriate ritual acts to please his deity, with only the start and final incantations fixed. It is permissible during this period to cast appropriate Goodly miracles - their cost is taken from the total cost of the rite. These miracles must be targeted or centred on the focus - not for example a Total Heal miracle cast on another party-member. Once the rite is complete, an uplifting feeling fills the radius, strong enough that any priest is aware of the presence of the powers of light here. For the duration of the rite all undead touch effects which would last 5 minutes instead last only 30 seconds, and other undead touch effects are halved in effect. Restore Life miracles require no candles. To disrupt the rite, its focus must first be freed from the Bless, either with a Curse or by slaying the caster, and then the focus either destroyed physically or moved outside the radius of the rite. This is not a releasable miracle.

name: Serin's Bound Spirit of Undeath
description: undead spirit to merge with the caster, granting them the undead touch effects of that creature (This includes limit in numbers). While active, the caster discerns as the relevant undead and if dismissed this miracle ends

name: Shaehan's Mercy
description: Cure light wounds every minute for 15 minutes.

name: Shield Against the Dark
description: This acts as a double-effect Spirit Shield but only applies to evil spiritual attacks. This miracle does not affect the undead.

name: Shield Blessing
description: Allows shield to parry purely spiritual blows

name: Sight of the Blind
description: Recipient must be a worshipper of St Michael. For duration of the miracle, the beneficiary may not see colours, read writing, see two-dimensional pictures or similar. However they gain full spirit-sight, which allows them to perceive spirits even when in walls or when normal vision is blocked by other non-spiritual barriers. It does not allow them to gain other information by spirit-sight, such as size or alignment of spirits. It also grants them the ability to see through spiritual darkness. This is a releasable miracle.

name: Song of Blood
description: One target is Level Drained and then Beguiled (as miracle). The lost level returns at the end of the miracle's duration. This miracle does not affect the undead. Dark Deliverers

name: Soothe the Pain
description: Cures the target 24/4 damage, as with most healing miracles this does not affect the undead.

name: Soul Lance
description: The caster sends a bolt of pure spiritual evil power at the target's spirit. If the target is goodly or neutral in Alignment they suffer tblp damage equal to 20% of their maximum tblp. SAC does not apply to this, although resistance to Soul Lance does. Evil targets are unaffected.

name: Soul Sharing
description: Recipient must be a willing goodly elf, drave, half-drave or half-elf. For the duration of the miracle the casting priest is considered to be in all ways 2 levels lower, as his spirit is shared with the target. The target, if an elf or drave, gains a half-spirit (as half-elf) for the duration, or if already half-elven gains a full spirit for the duration. It should be noted however that the miracle is released on death of either the caster or the recipient, and should the recipient die the caster cannot regain the lost levels until the end of the day. This miracle is not discharged by the use of magical powers by the recipient. This is a releasable miracle, but may only be voluntarily released with same gesture (linked hands) as the casting. It only works on living targets. Note: Technically, this miracle could be cast on any object at all, as the spirits cannot recognise elven nature, goodly or otherwise. However, once the target is infused with the caster's spirit it can be identified, and the spirit will immediately flee unless the target is valid, thus wasting the spirits cast on it.

name: Soul's Hunger
description: This miracle only functions when cast while the priest already has a Causing miracle 'hanging' on their hands. It means that if that Causing miracle successfully injures a living spirit their life essence is taken for the casting priest, instead of going to feed the evil spirits as is normal. This means that according to the miracle's power level, the priest is cured 3 tblp and 1 to each loc per spirit of the Cause miracle 30 seconds later - so that a Cause Grievous Wounds miracle heals 15 and 5 to each loc. However, each Resistance to Causing possessed by the target halves the benefit to the caster. The caster may not use this ability to target themselves with a Causing miracle. Only damaging Causing miracles combine with this miracle - not Cause Disease, for example, nor Degeneration. For ease of use in combat, the caster should call "Vampiric Cause XXX" when used - this allows the target (or the ref) to warn the priest if no benefit was received, within the 30 seconds before the curing is received. ~ 60 ~  Taint Spirit Level: 1sp Alignment: Evil Duration: Instant Sphere: Minor Necromancy Range: Touch Gesture: Touch Target with palms Verbal: “Spirits of death taint this form such that its death is final.” Description: When cast upon a dead body the body is treated as though it has been raised as an undead, without it actually rising up as an undead, preventing the dead body from being restored to life. Fortified Spirit grants immunity to this miracle. 2nd Level Evil Advanced Miracles

name: Spirit Form
description: The caster of this miracle is now only influenced by spiritual effects and damage, though physical barriers still block his motion. A Good or Evil version of this miracle is available also as a 8th (10sp) miracle. This miracle affects the undead. 40pts Tb 9: Post 6th Undead Multi-race may now cast the Evil version of this miracle as a 7th (8sp) miracle and post 6th Angel of War / Mercy Multi-race may now cast the Good version of this miracle as a 7th (8sp) miracle. NOTE: In both cases Spirit Form still counts as a 10sp miracle for the purpose of purchasing the miracle and this reduction may not be accumulated with any other reduction, such as that from Embody Wight Spirit (see below).

name: Spirit Rend
description: Once cast the Shaman has 30 seconds to touch a target who then takes the effect of 6 simultaneously cast Spiritbolts. SAC and Resistances to Spiritbolt apply separately to each Spiritbolt. This miracle will not affect members of the Shaman’s own tribe. ~ 77 ~  Witchcraft These miracles may only be acquired post 8th by a witch of the appropriate alignment. No other class or alignment may cast one of these miracles. Witchcraft ~ Evil

name: Spirit Shift
description: This miracle instantly transports the priest and his possessions across the indicated distance of up to 20' in a similar manner to the 6mp standard Blue Wizard Spell Blink. This includes the 2 seconds disorientation upon arrival.

name: Spirit Sight
description: Grants the caster active spirit sight for the duration.

name: Spirit Storm
description: All within the area excluding the caster receive a Spirit Bolt.

name: Spiritual Aegis
description: Must be able to cast Greater Spirit Shield. Acts as per a Spirit Shield but absorbs the first 72 points of damage. ~ 58 ~  Bound Force of Stasis Level: 8th (10sp) Alignment: Neutral Duration: 5 minutes Sphere: Major Force Range: Touch / Self Gesture: Touch weapon Verbal: “Spirits bide here and let all smitten stand and be held by thy power.” Description: Cast on a normal, non-supernatural weapon wielded by the caster the weapon has a spirit bound to it which allows the priest to strike non-damaging blows for ‘Stasis 9 levels’ (i.e. affecting 8th level and below targets) instead of normal damage, at will. The priest may alternate, striking a blow for Stasis, then a damaging blow, then a Stasis blow again, and so forth. This miracle does not affect the undead.

name: Spiritual Cataclysm
description: Acts as per a 144 tblp spirit bolt (48 HTK). Note the range of touch. After completing the verbal the caster has 30 seconds to touch the target. To learn this miracle the priest must be on table 11. ~ 59 ~  Communication with the Gods Level: 8th (16sp) Alignment: Neutral Duration: 2 minutes/5 minutes (see below) Sphere: Major Communication Range: Infinite Gesture: As Greater Communication Verbal: “All Seeing All K nowing Spirits, guardians of the unknown, knowers of knowledge, keepers of secrets, you whose vision and hearing are mighty grant me thy wisdom and understanding. Listen to me and converse for I have need of thy insight.” Description: As per Greater Communication but no limit to the number of questions asked and the spirits may respond to an individual question with more than just seven words. Questions must be asked in a measured and respectful manner, or no response will be gained. The caster may choose to have all questions be only regarding one specific area, in which case the divination lasts 5 minutes, or simply answering any questions they desire, in which case the duration is only two minutes but the miracle becomes far more versatile. In order to acquire this miracle must first possess Communication and Greater Communication.

name: Spiritual Watching
description: Grants +2 DAC as per bless but is not a bless

name: Steal Life Essence
description: todo

name: Storm of Power
description: As Voice of Power but all within radius of up to two levels below the caster are affected (i.e. 6th level characters are affected assuming the caster is 8th level). Releasing the miracle releases all targets simultaneously. This miracle does not affect the undead.

name: Strengthen the Spirit
description: The willing beneficiary gains the effects of Determination against non-magical stopping effects for the duration; that is to say, any stopping effect targeted on the beneficiary for the duration has no effect but costs the target 6 tblp to shrug it off. This is involuntary, and occurs even if the beneficiary was actually immune to the effect! This miracle does not affect the undead. ~ 46 ~  Light Of Purity Level: 6sp Alignment: Good Sphere: Minor Dismissal Duration: Instant Range: 20’ Gesture: Point at target Verbal: “Spirits of light blaze your glorious radiance upon this undead spirit and let it be consumed in your divine brilliance... Light of Purity!” Description: This miracle inflicts 12 spiritual hits on an undead, it has no effect on any other creature. On a Player Character undead it inflicts 36pts of damage as per Spiritbolt. However Resistance to Spirit-Bolt does not apply, although SAC does. Destroy Gaseous Form Level: Variable Alignment: Good Sphere: Major Dismissal Duration:5 minutes Range: 20’ Gesture: Point at target Verbal: “By the power of the spirits of light I bid that you return to your true form!” Description: This miracle costs spirits equal to the dismiss level of the target minus two (so 4 sp for use on a level 6 vampire) to cast. If the target is not undead it costs 6 spirits. This causes any one target which is benefiting from a Vampiric Gaseous Form to return to their normal form and then be unable to turn Gaseous for the remainder of the miracle’s duration. Immunity to Involuntary Shapeshifting grants immunity to this miracle’s effects. This miracle costs 40pts to buy

name: Strengthen Ward
description: May be cast on any Minor or Major Ward of Power that the priest has cast themselves. That Ward no longer has a duration, but lasts until the caster releases it or it is assaulted with sufficient miracle attacks to destroy it. However while the Ward remains, the spirits used on the Strengthen Ward miracle may not be regained. This is not a releasable miracle, although releasing the ward upon which it was cast will end it automatically. 4th Level Neutral Advanced Miracles

name: Stronghold of Goodness
description: This functions in all exactly as per a Protection from Spirits cast versus evil in every way except where noted above and will act as a barrier to keep out any evil spirit regardless of level. The miracle stops if the casting Priest leaves the area of effect. This miracle is releasable.

name: Stronghold of Hatred
description: This miracle is identical to the miracle Protection From Good Spirits in every way except where noted above and the fact that the barrier keeps out any good spirit regardless of level. 7th Level Evil Advanced Miracles Wild Evil Level: Variable* Duration: Instant Alignment: Evil Sphere: Universal Range:20' radius Gesture: See below Verbal: "Darkness feed on my essence and let all feel your touch!" to be shouted, followed by a declaration of the damage inflicted (see below) Description: As the verbal is incanted the caster must slash a body part with a dedicated ritual knife (which cannot be used in normal combat - it is permissible to carry this blade), inflicting 6 points of damage to the location and TBLP. The caster must be flesh-and-blood. The blood is then sucked from the wound by wild and hungry evil spirits that cluster around the priest. These spirits form a dark and evil maelstrom centred on the priest which inflicts 6/1 spiritual damage to all within the radius for each 2 spirits the priest releases, to a maximum of 12 spirits and 36/6 damage to all. SAC applies against this damage as normal, except for the casting priest, who cannot in any way shield against the attentions of the spirits, and must take the full damage. Should this miracle be cast a second time within an hour, the casting priest loses all remaining spirits to the uncontrolled evil spirits drawn to the bloodshed, including his own - thus dying. Damage from this second casting is still limited to 36/6 however. This miracle affects the undead, but may not be cast by them (as they have no blood). *This miracle costs 50pts to buy ~ 67 ~  Pact of Blood Level: 7th (8sp) Alignment: Evil Duration: 15 minutes Sphere: Universal Range: Touch Gesture: Touch with both hands Verbal: “Black spirits watch this one, and let the blood-shed he/she causes free thee to act as ye will." Description: This miracle ‘hangs’ on the hands of the caster for 30 seconds, in the same manner as causing miracles. While under the effect of this miracle each time the target draws the blood of a spiritual target (hits a flesh-and-blood creature with a sharp weapon for the first time) they are struck by the drawn evil spirits, taking 36/6 evil spiritual damage to which SAC applies (12 Hits to monsters). This damage is taken each time a new flesh-andblood target is struck after the miracle becomes active, but once taken from a given creature there is no further penalty for striking that creature again. This miracle does not affect the undead.

name: Stronghold Of Neutrality
description: This miracle is identical to the miracle Protection From Spirits except that it functions only against neutral spirits and will keep out any neutral spirit regardless of level. If cast by a neutral spirit user they will be unhindered by the miracle and able to cross it themselves. ~ 57 ~  8th Level Neutral Advanced Miracles

name: Summon Barrow-Wight
description: The miracle must be incanted over a corpse within a Protection from Good Spirits. This corpse need not be fresh, and in fact is often an ancient body within a tomb. At the incanting of the final words a dagger must be driven into the chest of the corpse, and from the wound the Barrow-Wight will arise. Barrow-Wights are shadowy, ethereal creatures called to guard the sanctity of an area. They are fully intelligent and may walk through walls at will in the same fashion as a wraith (suffering a 2-second disorientation on leaving). They have 25 supernatural hits, and inflict Purely Spiritual 9pt Double by unarmed blow. This does mean that magic hurts them, and for example an elf with a magic weapon could kill them while they could not harm it. Additionally their touch causes 2 points of permanent damage to the touched location (not tblp). This is an undead touch-effect, and no AC or damage reductions apply to it (having half a spirit means that only 1 point of perm is inflicted). This damage can only be cured by exposing the wounds to the rays of the next dawn (normally, lasts till end of adventure). Barrow-Wights are level 6 undead. A barrow-Wight will not willingly leave the area in which it was summoned, which may be a specific building if summoned within one, or a roughly 60' area otherwise. Even if controlled they will refuse to do so. They are banished whence they came by sunlight, and fear it terribly. ~ 70 ~  Summon Wraith-Warrior Level: 7th (8sp) Alignment: Evil Duration: 30 minutes Sphere: Major Necromancy Range: 3' Gesture: As Summon Wraith Verbal: "By all the powers of darkness, spirit of evil I summon thee forth! By the shades of the netherworld and blood you have shed, wraith warrior I name thee! I call thee from the land of the spirits! By my powers I summon thee here! Behold! By the power of my spirits thou art summoned here! Come forth!" Description: In all ways as Summon Wraith (not Wight), except that the summoned undead arrives equipped with dark and ethereal armour and sword. It now discerns as a Level 6 Wraith Warrior, has 16 spiritual Hits, and may inflict purely spiritual damage by weapon type + one weapon mastery with its sword, which no other may wield. It may also channel its powers of level-draining and fear through sword-blows. 8th Level Evil Advanced Miracles

name: Summon Haunt
description: This miracle summons a non corporeal spirit which inflicts Fear (as the miracle) by each touch at will. It is slain by a total of 12 spirit only hits. The Haunt has a Dismiss / Control level of 4 and is controlled by its summoner only for the first 5 minutes of its existence. The Haunt’s general outlook on life is that it likes to be scary, and should be given due respect, it is an intelligent undead. It may walk through walls at will, in the same fashion as a wraith.

name: Summon Rod of Power
description: Summons a purely spiritual 'O' class rod into the caster's hands. This weapon is +1 spiritual, and can only be wielded by the caster. It may not be thrown. The caster may call the weapon back to his hands at will with the phrase 'Rod to me!'. Strength may not be used with this weapon unless the appropriate tables ability is bought. This is a releasable miracle, and affects the undead.

name: Summon Wraith-Warrior
description: todo

name: Sunder Spirit
description: The effect of this miracle is as per Spirit Bolt but it inflicts 72 tblp [24HTK]. Resistances to Spirit Bolt and SAC apply as normal.

name: Taint of Blood
description: Should the target shed the blood of a spiritual being after this miracle is cast (use a sharp weapon against a flesh-and-blood target) evil spirits are drawn to cluster around them. As such, for the rest of the miracle's duration the target cannot benefit from goodly miracles and is considered 'Evil' for all disbeneficial spiritual purposes (e.g. crossing Protections). Additionally they will be unable to use goodly spiritual powers unless they possess Divine Guidance. An effect which repels Evil spirits will remove the miracle from a target unless they are themselves spiritually Evil.

name: Taint Spirit
description: todo

name: The Black Death
description: This acts as per the Cause Disease miracle, but begins at the 5 minute stage and progresses rapidly. Reaching the 10 minute stage after 1 minute, the 30 minute stage after 3, and death occurs at 5 minutes. People that have multi-raced Mummy may learn this as a minor causing miracle. ~ 73 ~  Treare’s Harm Level: 8th (12sp) Alignment: Evil Sphere: Major Causing Duration: Instant Range: Touch Gesture: Touch target Verbal: “Spirits of Darkness and Suffering answer my call! I summon you here to bring my foes low. Spirit feel now the anguish as they life suffers mortal….. Harm!” Description: Must be able to cast Touch of Death, and be on table 10. This miracle hangs for 30 seconds as with most causing miracles. When touched it causes the target to suffer causing equal to their starting tblp. SAC applies at 6 points for every point of SAC the target has. Resistances to causing then apply. This miracle costs the caster a level to cast (reductions can be purchased as per level loss from Touch of Death). It does not affect the undead.

name: The Empress' Sacrifice
description: todo

name: The Light Of Faith
description: Upon completion of the miracle all undead which are not permitted to enter daylight are feared and must leave the area immediately. Any other undead who enter suffer 4 spiritual hits, or 12 tblp to Player Character undead, this only affects them the first time they enter the area. No undead may spiritually Shift into or within the area for the duration of the miracle. If the caster leaves the area of effect for any reason then the miracle is cancelled.

name: The Touch of the Forge
description: Causes the chosen weapon to become +0 spirit for the duration. Additionally it counts as Master Status, making it immune to Shatter, Warp, Disintegrate, Melt, Magnetise, Vanish, and all similar effects.

name: The Tranquil Seas
description: One willing target becomes unable to enter any form of rage (willing or otherwise) for the duration. Additionally they gain purest self-defence restrictions. This is NOT a releasable miracle, and does effect the undead. The Forge

name: Torrent of the Netherworld
description: After casting the target has 30 seconds to touch the target. The target suffers a freeze, paralysis, fear, disease, and Level drain. All as per the undead touch effects (including that spirit shields apply vs. them). This miracle does effect the undead and is NOT releasable.

name: Unified Strength
description: The priest and at least two other people who are goodly spirits must link hands in a closed chain. All those who participate in the chain then gain +1 strength (max +2), +1 level of resistance to Evil spirits, and a Spirit Shield. Only goodly people may benefit. ~ 84 ~  Talthar Blessing of the Aspects of Hope Level: See miracle Alignment: Good Duration: 24 hours Faith: Talthar Range: Self Gesture: Kneel in prayer Verbal: “Spirits of hope I call to thee. Grant me the watching of the aspect of ….” Description: This is learnt as a 7th level (8 spirit) miracle. The caster chooses one of the aspects of Talthar and draws power from it. This causes them to gain benefits from one of the aspects as per the current guild benefits listed in the Almanac. It costs 4 spirits to gain basic tier, 8 for intermediate and 12 for advanced. The priest may only have this miracle active for one aspect at a time, and may only be cast once per aspect per day. This is a releasable miracle. Tsu-Ling

name: Voice of Command
description: This miracle is as Voice of Power except that it affects targets of a level equal to the caster, rather than one below, making it far more versatile. Note however the extremely short duration! This miracle does not affect the undead. ~ 55 ~  Spirit Sundering Level: 6sp Alignment: Neutral Duration: Instant Sphere: Major Force Range: 20’ Gesture: Point at Spirit Verbal: “By all the powers of the spirits let thy spirit be smitten and struck…” Description: This miracle affects the target as a double-effect Spirit Bolt, doing 36 tblp of neutral spirit damage to the target, with SAC and resistances to Spirit Bolt applying appropriately. [Note that Dark Sundering is an identical evil version of this miracle, and also available as Major Force Sphere – Evil priests may therefore buy either if desired.]

description: May be cast on any Minor Ward of Power or Major Ward of Power, or other similar non-standard miracles at ref's discretion. The affected Ward no longer bars undead from crossing in any fashion, nor damages them. It otherwise functions as normal. This is a releasable miracle. Dead Heroes

name: Wings of Darkness
description: This miracle will allow the caster to turn a Causing tree or Sphere miracle up to 6th level that they currently have ‘hanging’ into a ranged attack. Must possess Lesser Wings of Darkness. 3rd Level Evil Advanced Miracles

name: Word of Banishment
description: Allows the caster to cast Dismiss Ghoul at will for 3 tblp for the duration (full verbal required). This is a releasable miracle, and clearly does effect the undead. 8th Level Goodly Advanced Miracles

name: Word of Recall
description: This miracle returns the Priest to his temple across any distance or barrier including time, whilst travelling the Priest is safe from any attack. It is impossible to prevent this miracle from working if it is successfully cast by a priest with sufficient remaining spirits. A Good or Evil version of this miracle is available also as a 8th (10sp) miracle.

name: Wound Staunch
description: This miracle enables the caster to completely heal any tblp damage that the target has taken, if 30 seconds of calm preparation are spent with the recipient before casting (cf. Total Heal). This miracle does not cure locational damage and on a creature with only half a spirit this miracle will not cure more than 72pts of damage. If the miracle is not prepared for (see Total Heal), it cures only 72 tblp or 36 tblp for a creature with half a spirit. This miracle does not affect the undead.

name: Wraith's Touch (Level Drain)
description: todo

name: Wrath of the Lord
description: This miracle may only ever be cast by the current High Priest of an existing church (with seven or more members, etc) – even if bought while High Priest, should a character lose that status it may no longer be used. Shaman may learn this miracle and apply it to the death of their tribe-members or attacks on them. It may only be cast on a target who has either harmed the High Priest or slain a member of the guild within the last 5 minutes. The target suffers 48 tblp, 8 to every location, and is knocked to the ground and is unable to act for 30 seconds or until struck, regardless of level (This stunning effect is as per a non-level based stasis). Spiritual AC applies at 6/1 per point to the damage but the only way to avoid being knocked to the ground is to have Resistance to Wrath of the Lord or half a spirit. Border

name: Writhe
description: Causes the target to collapse in agony as per a spasm (immunity to spasm applies). Resistances to causing reduce the time the miracle lasts by 15 seconds per resistance owned. If a resistance to causing is owned then the effects of this miracle will break if the target suffers damage. This miracle does effect the undead and is releasable. 4th Level Evil Advanced Miracles

name: Spiritual Freedom
description: This miracle enables the priest to remove a Spiritual Mastery miracle. It also removes Beguile and Befriend Spirit miracles and will remove any physical versions of the above.

name: Regeneration
description: This miracle enables a priest to regenerate a severed limb. On completion of the incantation, the limb will begin to grow and it will be fully usable after 5 minutes. This miracle only works on living targets. In the case of missing body-parts other than limbs, such as the eyes, the miracle's effects are generally deemed to be instant, at ref's discretion. This miracle does not affect the undead.

name: Reveal Truth
description: This miracle enables a priest to ask a spirit whether a statement he has heard recently has been the truth or a lie. The statement must have been made by a being with a spirit. The ref should inform the caster whether the speaker believed the statement or did not believe it (i.e. was lying). The actual truth of the statement does not matter, only the speaker's perception of it. Rather than repeating the statement, the priest may simply utter the verbal immediately after a statement – in this case the miracle affects the last statement heard, whatever that may have been. In a change from previous this now allows statements to be checked for a 5minute period. Each statement must be repeated or the verbal used after each one. Alternatively a single statement may be checked at any time after it has been heard. Differences/Additional rules: a Conceal Lie miracle does not work against it. For the duration of the miracle the priest recognises any and all lies spoken by someone with a spirit.

name: Total Heal
description: This miracle enables a priest to totally heal a character or monster of all damage, if both priest and recipient spend 30 seconds in calm preparation before the invocation, the priest praying to their patron and neither party in combat. If the miracle is cast without this preparation it cures only 72 tblp and 72 points of locational damage. This is an absolute system limit, and no ability under any circumstances circumvents this. Note that on creatures with half a spirit, like half-Elves, Total Heal only cures 72 points as above if prepared and only 36 points if unprepared. This miracle does not affect the undead.

name: Restore Life
description: This miracle allows a recently dead (up to 2 weeks of real time) character or monster to be brought back to life. The priest is drained of a level if this miracle is used successfully – immunity to level drain and similar abilities do not apply to this loss, as the miracle is cast voluntarily. The body should be placed in a circle of Protection from Spirits (evil) with a lit candle (or safe phys rep candle) at each shoulder and at each foot. If the miracle is successful, the person restored to life has 7 total body life points and 1 location life point at each location (even if they had suffered unhealable wounds that would prevent this). A monster, if resurrected, has 2 hits. If for any reason this miracle fails to work, then the priest still loses 10 spirits and 10 life points. If the person remains at rest within the general area (20ft) of where they were restored to life do not cast/engage in combat they will be completely healed 5 minutes later. Note there is no longer a "disease" effect associated with a restore life. If a character has died from Level Drain then they are returned at

name: Spirit of Seeing and Hearing
description: This miracle is very similar to the Spirit of Seeing miracle. It has all the effects of a Spirit of Seeing and can also read the surface thoughts of any spirits in the area and so tell their short-term intent. In general, non- animate spirits, such as those in items or active miracles, will not have thoughts!

name: Stasis
description: The effects of this miracle are as the Halt miracle in most ways except for Range and duration. The only other difference is that a touch is not sufficient to free the target of a Stasis – only actual damage will suffice.

name: Detect Lie
description: This miracle enables a priest to ask a spirit whether a statement he has heard recently has been the truth or a lie. The statement must have been made by a being with a spirit. The ref should inform the caster whether the speaker believed the statement or did not believe it (i.e. was lying). The actual truth of the statement does not matter, only the speaker's perception of it. Rather than repeating the statement, the priest may simply utter the verbal immediately after a statement – in this case the miracle affects the last statement heard, whatever that may have been. In a change from previous this now allows statements to be checked for a 5minute period. Each statement must be repeated or the verbal used after each one. Alternatively a single statement may be checked at any time after it has been heard.

name: Control Mummy
description: This miracle enables a priest to take over control of a spirit animating a zombie. If the level of the priest performing the miracle is higher or equal to the level of the priest currently controlling the zombie, then the miracle succeeds otherwise it fails. For control purposes, an uncontrolled zombie or a zombie under the control that is inherent in the Animate Zombie miracle, is considered to be controlled only by a Differences/Additional rules: one level 4 or below undead is affected.

name: Spiritual Invisibility
description: The caster's spirit cannot be perceived by any spirit and thus is immune to ALL spiritual effects. This includes all miracles. The caster cannot cast miracles or even use innate (spiritual) abilities, excepting that the priest may remove his own Spiritual Invisibility miracle. Spiritual Invisibility can only be cast on the caster. This miracle does not affect the undead.

name: Animate Zombie
description: This miracle enables a priest to summon spirits to enter dead bodies to create zombies. A priest can generally create zombies out of bodies that are up to 28 days old, or otherwise ruled by the ref to have remained fleshy. The priest is able to animate 4 hits + 1 hit per level of the priest in zombies and can spread this number of hits amongst the zombies in any combination he likes. e.g. A

name: Temporary Curse
description: This miracle enables a priest to curse a person for a limited period of time. The effect of this miracle is to spiritually slow the victim's reactions to the extent that the victim loses 2 points of dexterity AC, to a minimum of 0. If this miracle is cast on a monster then it reduces the monster's AC by 2 points alternatively if the monster is not set with AC it decreases the monsters remaining hits by four. The minimum hits a monster can be left with after being cursed is one, as clearly the miracle cannot kill but merely increase the amount of damage the victim receives during combat. This miracle is also known as 'Damn'. Alternatively, the miracle can be cast upon a target of Evil alignment beneficially, instead granting them 2 Dexterity AC in a manner similar to Temporary Bless. However in this case the miracle lasts only 5 minutes. Objects may also be cursed, and this functions as detailed under Temporary Bless. All priests of any alignment are able to cast a miracle of equivalent effect to Damn, as a final dying Damn, as long as they have at least 2 spirits remaining. The priest need not have this miracle on his guild miracle list though he must be at least second level. The dying priest always has enough time to utter the incantation before he expires providing he says it at the instant of death. The verbal for this curse is "With my dying breath I damn thee". This miracle if cast as a dying damn, is not removed by the involuntary Remove Own Miracle cast during the death trauma. The priest is deemed to spend the agony of his death trauma willing retribution on his slayer. This miracle cancels the effect of a Temporary Bless, though it has no effect on a full Bless.

name: Conceal Lie
description: This miracle enables a priest to counteract the effects of a Detect Lie miracle, or any other form of Lie Detection power used by someone with a spirit, such as neuronic Detect Lie. Clearly it could be used to withstand the inquisition of the Paladin ability to Detect Lie. However, blatant lies cannot be concealed and it must be cast before the false statements are made. The casting priest can always elect to allow a Detect Lie miracle to work on him at any time during this miracle's duration. These evil types can be really tricky!

name: Spiritual Mastery
description: This miracle enables the priest to summon a spirit to take control of a character or monster. Short of suicide, the victim will do the priest's bidding unhesitatingly and without question. A "controlled" priest loses the ability to use any good aligned miracles whilst "controlled". If a spiritually mastered character should increase in levels to parity with the level of the priest when he performed the spiritual mastery, the spiritual mastery still holds but the character may distort any of his master's instructions. Note that the target may still perform actions of their choice as long as these do not conflict with any orders given to them by their master. A person can only have one spiritual mastery spirit within his body at any one time. The latest spiritual mastery overrides any other, but if the previous master is of a higher level then his spiritual mastery holds. A priest may only have a number of victims up to his level of experience mastered at one time, and these should be recorded on the priest's character card. A person detects as being spiritually evil whilst spiritually mastered and has this additional spirit hovering around the body. This miracle only works on characters of less than the caster's level. It does not affect the undead.

name: Summon Wraith
description: This miracle enables a priest to summon a wraith (or wight) from the spirit plane. The ritual to summon a wraith is as follows. 1. Obtain the name of the wraith (any evil priest of suitable level can be assumed to have learnt some of these names as part of their training, so this simply requires a suitable in character name to be chosen). 2. Inscribe the name on a scroll of parchment. 3. Place the scroll within a circle of Protection from Goodly Spirits. 4. Utter the incantation while holding a ritual dagger. 5. Throw the dagger into the circle while repeating the 'By my powers...' section of the incantation. 6. The wraith will appear in the circle at the end of the incantation under the control of the summoner. The wraith is under the control of the summoner (the Summon Wraith miracle gives a weak control equivalent to a Control Wraith miracle as if cast by a

name: Suspend Life
description: Once the priest has finished incanting the verbal, he has 30 seconds in which to touch the victim of the miracle with the open palms of both hands. If he does so, then the victim falls unconscious. This is a listed stopping effect. The victim is not dead and has a very faint pulse (only discern nature of wounds or similar will tell that the character is still alive). If he receives 5 points of spiritual curing to every location he can regain consciousness. This miracle just renders its victim unconscious, it does not do any damage. This miracle does not affect the undead.

name: Summon Vampire
description: This miracle enables a priest to summon a vampire from the spirit plane. The ritual to summon a vampire is as follows: 1) A vampire name must be used (see notes under Summon Wraith for comments on these) 2) Inscribe the name on a living human/humanoid "sacrifice" (this should be phys-repped but not necessarily made visible) 3) Place the sacrifice in a circle of Protection from Spirits (good), draw in chalk and then seal the circle from the outside. 4) Cast the incantation, the vampire spirit will appear 5 minutes after the end of the incantation. It will then enter the body of the sacrifice so slaying the sacrifice. The vampire so summoned is not in any way controlled by the priest and so must be persuaded to do any task the priest wishes done. A vampire is not to be trifled with; requests to bring in the milk etc. are unlikely to be greeted with delight. Remember it could still be there when your own protection runs out! N.B. A vampire cannot be summoned in daylight.

name: Touch of Death
description: Once the priest has finished incanting the verbal, he has 30 seconds in which to touch the victim of the miracle with the open palms of both hands. If he does so, then the victim falls unconscious. This is a listed stopping effect. The victim is not dead and has a very faint pulse (only discern nature of wounds or similar will tell that the character is still alive). If he receives 5 points of spiritual curing to every location he can regain consciousness. This miracle just renders its victim unconscious, it does not do any damage. This miracle does not affect the undead. Differences/Additional rules: if used successfully the victim is instantly killed. A character (or monster) killed by this miracle cannot benefit from a Restore Life miracle, or be restored to life in any way. This DOES NOT apply should the victim have had resistances acquired post-8th to the Touch, so that they only suffer damage rather than dying outright – if this damage slays them then the death is not permanent. The priest must be standing in a Protection from Spirits (good) miracle whilst casting the miracle. After shouting the incantation the priest has 30 seconds to touch his victim with both hands, if he fails to do so, the miracle fails. If the victim has no resistance to the miracle, the priest has a 70% chance of this miracle working and an additional 10% chance for every time the victim has previously been killed. If the miracle works then the casting priest loses a level. If for any reason the miracle fails, then the priest still loses the standard 10 spirit and 10 life points, but not a level. Obviously if someone has died three times already and has no Resistance to the miracle then they automatically die. In addition if the victim lives through the miracle as a result of a successful dice roll he suffers the effects of the Suspend Life miracle instead, to which no further resistance may be applied. This miracle does not affect the undead. Information Concerning the Undead The term undead generally refers to creatures that have passed the stage of death and are somehow held in a state of continued existence, almost always by evil spiritual power. Physical undead use the corpse of a dead creature to hold the spirit, and the spirit moves the body even as it rots slowly away. Incorporeal undead are just spirits, called from the netherworld where they reside to the prime plane. There are many, many different sorts of undead, ranging from simple unintelligent spirits which can only follow basic commands right through to spirits which are at least as clever as the humans who may summon them, and can be truly powerful. Only seven sorts of undead are universally known of, and these are listed below – other sorts are less common and their natures may vary widely. Full undead all see with spirit sight, whether they also have physical eyesight as well or not. Their spirit sight is 'active', and allows them to see all spirits within the range of normal sight, as well as recognising alignment and seeing even through solid physical barriers to see spirits behind them. Fresher physical undead, or well-preserved ones, may also have physical eyes – without these, they will not be able to see creatures like elves or priests who have hidden their spirits. Even undead who have no means of transportation other than physical movement can be ordered to return to their own plane by a controlling priest, in which case their spirit immediately does so, leaving behind the body they may have had possession of. Zombie A zombie is a mindless, unintelligent undead. It can be animated from the body of a recently dead humanoid, man- sized creature. A body can generally be animated as a zombie up to 1 lunar month (28 days) after the original death of the body. A zombie can only inflict damage of Single with one handed weapons, or Double with a two handed weapon. Zombies move very slowly, generally described as 'half-speed', meaning that a competent and agile warrior should have little trouble besting one in combat. They have a dismiss level of 1. If a zombie moves more than 18' (6 paces) away from its point of animation it collapses lifeless, never to move again. Skeleton A skeleton is also an unintelligent undead. It can be animated from a well decayed body of a dead humanoid creature of man-size. It can wield weapons in the same way as zombies, albeit faster. Their resistance to sharp weapons and their ability to move at full speed makes them relatively dangerous opponents. They have a dismiss level of 2. If a skeleton moves more than 18' (6 paces) away from its point of animation it collapses lifeless, never to move again. Ghoul A ghoul is a semi-intelligent undead. It can be created from the body of a recently dead humanoid, man-sized creature. A body can be used in the creation of ghoul up to 2 weeks (14 days) after the original death of the body. They have an animal-like cunning, and an ability to think that parallels the most intelligent of wild beasts. They will sometimes hunt in packs, and often drag helpless victims off for later feeding. A ghoul cannot be created in daylight and when created, will never venture out into daylight. Unlike zombies, skeletons and mummies, ghouls eat flesh where possible. A ghoul eats dead humanoids and prefers to eat 1 man-sized body per week to survive. A ghoul will only venture from its place of creation if it is:  Controlled  Feeding  If its place of creation is outdoors A ghoul can paralyse its victims by merely striking them, the results in them being unable to move for 5 minutes. In addition its unarmed blows do Single. The paralysis is a spiritual effect. If a ghoul is able to feed regularly its body remains in relatively good repair, and they maintain their physical eyesight indefinitely. Ghouls have a dismiss level of 3. Mummy A mummy is a semi-intelligent undead. It can be created from a specially prepared body provided it is humanoid and man-sized. The embalming process generally means that mummies keep their physical eye-sight indefinitely. The special preparations are that the body must be embalmed, within 7 days of its death, in special embalming bandages and then a Cause Disease miracle must be cast upon the body some time before the Create Mummy miracle is to be cast. If Cause Disease is not cast upon the body then the mummy will not cause disease with touch. A mummy is not restricted to its point of creation and may venture into daylight. It inflicts 9 point Double with its hands only and its touch inflicts disease on its victim as per the miracle. It has a dismiss level of 4. Wraith A wraith is an intelligent purely spiritual undead. It can be summoned anywhere as long as it is not in bright light or daylight, which it will not willingly enter. A wraith does not cause damage but is able to drain levels by touch.
